Their incredible use of sensors programming and robust systems led them to consistently strong openings in every match. Taking the idea of automation to heart, this teams autonomous systems was the seasoning on a great design.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team was willing to sail towards risk to achieve the climb. Bringing new ideas and materials to get up on the stage, this robot defied gravity and convention. These energetic warriors elevated themselves on invisible threads of innovation.

This team has a rich history of planting a seed to those that are close to them, and their community. Just like leaves and branches on a tree, their outreach expands borders through their dedication, innovative spirit, and commitment to inspiring the next generation of students. Through their unique workshops focused on each individual letter of STEM, this team is on a mission to start a forest of engineering wizards!

This team has a formula for success that reaches far beyond the playing field. Through their innovative approach, they have been transforming culture to bring FIRST and STEAM to individuals who may otherwise not have seen it in themselves. This team sustains a culture of inclusivity within their own team, to newcomer and refugee youth, their community, and internationally. They have held all-girl events focussing on STEM as well as holding workshops for teachers who are new to FIRST. In their own words, "A good theory is one that creates breakthroughs for everyone."

Ascending like the first humans beyond the stratosphere, this team hit the mark when it came to their custom designed components. Guided by their detailed engineering documentation, they navigated the complexities of design and implementation with the precision of a spacecraft on its journey to the stars.

The judges were impressed with the way the winning team exemplified FIRST core values while reaching out to the competition. The winning team helped other teams with money, mentoring, and even spare parts. The judges could only exclaim "WHAT's UP DOC!"

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team took this year's theme of the game to create an unforgettable show. They 'EFFECT'-ively incorporated sound, vision, appearance, and safety into an orchestra. Just like multiple colours blend to make purple, this team found multiple ways to create their unique identity.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: With a color coordinated robot that balances both form and function, they have creatively used 3D printing and advanced manufacturing techniques to produce a robot that both looks good and performs on the field. In the spirit of St. Patrick's Day, this team has embraced their Celtic heritage and brought the green to the game.

This team came swooping in to the competition. The robot supported their drive team through LED signaling and robust autonomous functions. Even with no April Tag in sight, this predator robot still knows where the prey is.

The team demonstrated to the judges that with a focus of simplicity, their team can build an efficient and optimized robot. This team does not shy away from a challenge. They work within their limitations to soar above adversity. Just like a bird they put the trust in themselves and not the branch, because they know they can fly.
Worming their way to the top of the heap, their well built robot has a steady focus on quality. This team stands tall like a flower in the garden.

The judges were amazed at the massive enthusiasm of members of this winning team. There is no surprise that they were able to build a HUGE team within their first year. Despite the team's initial difficulties finding sponsors, their persistence eventually had a SILVER lining, and they now have developed strong, mutual, and productive relationships. The team members are truly KNIGHTS in shining armour.

This rookie team has made a great FIRST impression on the judges. Despite being a young team, they have exhibited great maturity by assisting other teams to the best of their ability and reaching out to their community and to FIRST. They have carried the LOAD of their rookie season and we are excited to see HAROLD back next season.

This team is a cultural hub within their community, working hard to thread inclusivity and enthusiasm in their organizational fabric. They accept all, showing support for each other under one banner. As the team cheers on their root from the sidelines, they are unified as one.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their focus on aligning their program to global sustainability goals. They incorporated recycled parts on their robot to mentoring other FIRST teams in their community. The judges believe this team is on a trajectory to success by exploring eco-friendly alternatives for team sustainability.
This team took NO SHORTCUT to victory. They harmonized their VISIONS with the available technology to achieve a symphony of success. They truly CLOSED THE WINDOW on their competition.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team’s robot SWERVED their way across the field scooping up notes. Their creative approach came from LOOKING IN A DIFFERENT DIRECTION than everyone else. By looking to the side to grab their notes, this team’s creative SIDE INPUT uniquely solved the problem.

This team is the POSTER CHILD for expanding the boundaries of science and technology education. They have advanced awareness of science and engineering across diverse platforms and CONNECT-ED with various communities to accomplish the FIRST mission. They have become a powerhouse to increasing women in STEP programs.

We are one world at FIRST, and this team embodies the spirit of unity. They have taken the average percentage of high school graduates through the roof, boasting a 100% success rate for their members. They are breaking barriers by drawing members from all over the GTA to participate in this incredible team. They have taken their enthusiasm into disadvantaged neighbourhoods to active change minds and change culture—inspiring kids that would otherwise divert from pursuing STEAM. They have started to address GREEN challenges and we look forward to further advances in bringing these issues into the FIRST world. As conscientious community leaders, this team helps the elderly with electronic literacy and they have presented at numerous Black History events to much acclaim and amazement.

Among many excellent teams on the fields, this team is positively mythological. Their engineering technical booklet meticulously detailed every modification made to their robot, accompanied by explanations of how each change conferred advantages on the field during matches, resulting in a rich seam of data to be mined. This teams POINTS THE WAY to excellence

The Judges’ interest was SPARKED when they heard about this teams’ sportsmanship. Not only did they share their practice space, they also DRILLED DOWN to share resources and expertise when the competition had a SHOCK. They helped POWER the day with their teamwork and gracious professionalism.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: They’re old, but they’re not rusty! Their team, supporters, robot, and controls MESH TOGETHER LIKE GEARS. Their logo is so cute, we can BARELY BEAR it!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: They are out to change the world with their new age thinking. When a note is stuck in their robot’s throat, they can SHIFT gears to fix it. They create a new PARADIGM with their industrial design.

This MIGHTY team shows their heart in October. The uniqueness of the control system which minimizes shifting stands out, just like their name. This strong and exceptional school THINKS PINK to raise awareness for breast cancer.

This young and diverse team demonstrates that the future of FIRST is secure. With a strong female contingent, they come from and represent the heart of Toronto’s burgeoning immigrant community. They engage with both their own neighbourhoods and those around them, living by the principles of FIRST. The future belongs to those who dare.
This blue GIANT team hides their wiring very well. Their COLOSSUS BOT was designed in a neat and simple way as a faultless structure. They amazed the field with QUALIFIED SMT.

This team ROARS with passion about science and technology with their school and community. By establishing sophisticated training programs and thorough safety protocols, this team has amassed over 60 members on their All-Star debut. They lead the PACK with PRIDE, forging strong partnerships with MANE-IFICENT dedication to FIRST ideals.

This team emerged new and SAILED into the competition. Through community workshops, STEM carnivals, and hackathons - they advance science and technology, and propel the FIRST mission. They INSPIRE RED passion as they A-CREW members and bring education and outreach into fruition.

This FUN LOVING team embraces great energy and unity at their core. This team dazzled with their unwavering enthusiasm, consistency, and positive engagement throughout the event. In our FIRST GALAXY filled with bright stars, they shine vibrant as a constellation.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Their team is older than most of their members. They know how to keep the light on sustainably—they FEATHER THEIR NEST with recycled parts and NUTURE THEIR YOUNG so that they can soar high. These notorious birds are ANYTHING BUT CHICKENS.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team charges valiantly into battle, with or without a human driver. When the robot takes the reins from the human player, their steed’s bright eyes draw them consistently to their target. The infrared projectors allow them to light up the field to shoot precisely.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: It’s hard to steer a robot just right, so when you’re a bit off-key, this team’s robot will still pick up the note. When you’re stuck between a rock and a hard place, their creativity shows the way.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team may be old but they’re still one of the best, since they’re now teaching the ABC’s of FIRST. They are wild about cleaning up their community, and they ferociously share their knowledge and experience with the world. Taking a byte out of life this team is here to inspire!

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: Wild! This team is just wild about learning and helping their community, both within FIRST and more broadly. With support of Friends and Family, they have taken the FIRST mission to new levels of Engineering and Science. With their commitment to FIRST, they have never waffled.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: When it comes to design, it's hard to be professional; however, this team did not get lost in the space of professional design. While orbiting the game strategy with their Shintake, this team has found Planet Robotics.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team cooperatively built a collective FRC practice field. They celebrate diversity, inclusivity and true sportsmanship. Despite their name, they ensure a safe space for all, with no raids!!

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: The winning team’s theme seamlessly blended art, design, and engineering, showcasing a banksy-esque approach to street art. Their two schools come together to sing the same tune, displaying their teamwork and diversity. This team is sure to dance to the crescendo of hip hop beats.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: When it comes to robustness in the design process, the team had focus like a predator. They approached every aspect of their robot balancing practicality, strength, and beauty, building a flashy machine with copper-coloured steel. This team really has its talons in the industrial design principles.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team considers their robot to be a member of the team. They trust it with some tasks on the field to secure their wins. Over time, they managed to convert a troublesome cousin into a rebel.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: For a team with outstanding Autonomy, they also showed Creativity in their approach to community partnership. They took their best shot at a Quality robot, Engineered and Designed to dominate the playing field. This long-lived team’s unique marketing efforts are the best thing since sliced bread. Winning the judges' award for community partnership...

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: The playing field has lots of sharp pointed objects just waiting to take out a robot. Plenty of green shielding will keep the robot’s precise design from harm. This robot was built to the quality standard of a traditional blacksmith.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: These rookies are passionate about inspiring all people to dip their oars into STEM. They discovered that by helping others, it helped them further their own goals and reach new shores. They are sharing their experience on Instagram and through a STEM carnival, and exploring new worlds like Vikings of old.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: An energetic team who, in their first year, jumped the moat and exemplified community outreach. They have built a castle to code and were outstanding in their safety measures. Last year they scouted their tournament, and this year are jousting with the best.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team’s enthusiasm and spirit radiates in all directions: from inspiring the curiosity of the young, to fostering a community among colleagues, to bringing diverse industry expertise to their endeavours. In their eyes, pre-season bootcamps are an opportunity for growth and FUN!! Their EdTalks are poised to be a great learning artifact for all teams.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Tying their talent stream with ongoing design efficiency under constrained finances is no easy task for any team. This team’s cohesive approach to simplifying design and cost-efficient, environmentally-friendly prototyping is magical. They make the classic project management trade offs almost mythical.

records.script: Sparks are flying on the field. This team positions itself to succeed and it delivers Autonomously. Their Robo knows and does not disappoint.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team shined above all. They have brilliance from libraries and teamwork. Their creativity was as bright as their team colors.
Driving up the Mountain and down the river Inspiring the next generation of FIRST students No Longer just an Annex, this team definitely inspired the judges
From starting FLL teams, to working at events. This First Impact Award winner spread the FIRST message all around their community. This team hit every note in the scale to win this award.
When there is static in the air, you know they’re approaching. They built a solid machine to “trap” that energy. And a well grounded team for weathering the storm.
When others were lost in the dark, this team led the way. The brought teams in from the rain and shared parts galore. I am sure you have seen these helpers in yellow and orange.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Whose team’s color is that royalty? Why do others associate their squeaks with quality and spunkyness? Please welcome a team who came from initial FLL World success!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: When others go high, this team went low While speakers are cool, their amps provide power and score points There steely design was strategically driven
This team really lit up the field as it captured the notes. They used a fusion of sensors to swerve their way to victory. With a refined AIM, this BOT maximized their cycle time.
The Change the System Award: While others do a one-off, this team built an operating system. They focused on girls who are determined to change the system This team is the place to be.
Riding the wave of notes Their robust machine took command of the field You will not get a SHOCK from this quality robot

In just a few months since starting, this team is already making a difference in their tribe. From donating LEGO kits and leading Scratch code competitions to handing out Valentines with their robot We can already hear their “roar”!

Despite it being their first year, this team has blown the judges out of the water. They took on the challenge of using a swerve drive and a double elevator mechanism, And paid off on the field All the way from our state capital.
Cheer up and tip your hat, and they won’t make you walk the plank. They venture forth and energize the stadium. When the spirit calls, they “ARR” a crew ready to answer.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: The winds of change start from a whisper. This team is preparing others for when they are not there. The chaos will come but they will fly like a butterfly.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.script: This team's speed, accuracy, and reliability beats the competition to a pulp. They succeeded in combining advanced path planning, custom localization, and visual serving. Nabing notes, making shots, this team's autonomous makes them a mean competitor.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team went from miniature designs to great heights. They sprang to work creating a balanced design. This team clawed their way to the top

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.script: This team's engineering cogs are always turning They have brought engineering joy to children across Oregon We "SERTainly" can't wait to see their engineering baby go.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.script: These operatives knew their district well and infiltrated it effectively. They focused on recruiting FTC & FLL potentials and even FRC competitors to continue their ongoing espionage. This team has advanced beyond Top Secret.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.script: You’ll need barbecue sauce to take down all the nuggets of genius this team shared. They turned up the heat on documentation and design, and hatched a clear plan for success. This team is on fire with excellence in engineering.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.script: While this team's mascot is known for their selfish, marauding ways and fighting demeanor....... The actual members of this team have demonstrated a very different ethos over the past two days. These supposed blackguards have generously shared resources and spread goodwill to the other teams in ways that make us question their "scalawag" moniker.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen

records.script: From across the big ripple with an environmental hue, This team's bot graces our tournament with a model of efficiency and practical design They wear the green banded nats in honor of their 4 leaf name!

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.script: This team's control enabled them to command the field. From intuitive user controls, to feed-forward modeling, to feedback control, they excelled. This team's control innovation helps them march forward to victory.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fairgrounds Event
records.script: When their cup of joe burnt their hand And they had to wrangle the serpent, python This dedicated warrior, Apollo, took the hill.

records.script: Sustainability sourced this team designed and executed a robot with quality craftsmanship Welded together, this team of nerds can withstand any crash. And believe me, there was extensive crash testing. This robot lights up the room and moooooooooooves hearts.

records.script: We’ll be singing this team’s praises for years to come. They turned up the volume and left us feeling anything but blue. Even in camo, it was impossible to miss their glowing spirit.

records.teamName: SWARM - South and West Albany Robotics Maniacs

records.script: This team has made a tremendous impact both in their school and their community. They’ve run Maker Camps, hosted kickoff events, and developed community engineering projects that have spread the FIRST message far beyond their own backyard. And, despite difficulty in fully engaging any FLL or FTC feeder teams, they have generated so much interest in robotics that they created a completely new second FRC team at their school.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow

records.script: This team had the mindset of less is more. They didn't want to click any superfluous buttons. Some could say their robot made decisions as fast a CAR.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team exemplifies innovation leveraging simplicity and elegance - pivoting on point. Through optimized design attributes, their creativity was eye opening, and they were light on their wheels. This team exemplifies thinking outside of their BUCKET.

This team pulls and spreads it's members across a large area RUNNING their own fundraisers. They chart their course to continuous improvement. Their name may be quite crazy, but they inspire all of us!
A community team that inspires success in STEM FLL, FTC, FRC in a row all down the hall Failing forward, say it with us, Oh my lordy, …..

This team demonstrated their structed and and mature approach to design and play execution. Excellence has been achieve through design ethos, a focus on learning, and leveraging strengths of each member This team exceeds expectations in embodiment of engineering professionalism.

When their members needed a little help, this team SWAM into action. They help deconflict interpersonal issues among team members to make a more inclusive environment for everyone. They have a great GRASP of gracious professionalism.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team will inspire you to leave your comfort zone and explore other worlds. They do it with a great mixture of professionalism and fun! This team's imagery was truly out-of-this-world!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team built a robot that is both elegant and functional. Their robust design process makes it more than the sum of their components. They bring the harmony of industrial design.

This team didn't only want to rely on LEDs or limelights to tell them what was going on. Custom code on a Pi gave them high confidence when looking for notes. Changing control orientation and a backup red-bar gave their driver confidence.
The season is a journey for all teams. This team's story lead us down a stony path, where the students and robots were the characters. The Judges award for IMMERSIVE WORLDBUILDING goes to....

This team charted a path for fabrication and maintainability through their sparing model. They excelled with the approach of utilizing maintenance concepts that support an overall quality to all that they do. This team's approach to logging and dashboards exemplifies the quality to design and execution.
This team executes the mission of FIRST Their imagery was never clandestine There's not sneaking past these Spy Guys
When it comes to cheerful optimism , this team leads the charge. They have a method for celebrating success and every step of the way, they have a HOOT!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Everyday, gamers need a little help with finding a plan. They need a intelligent risk aversion at hand. Luckily, this team has a few lawyers on demand.

When they charged across the field scoring notes left and right. They were the steadiest presence on the field, their robot scored multiple times. They commanded an army toward the autonomous award throughout all stages of the game. Congratulations team number 3015.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Orange you glad they made the trek? From their meticulous intake iterations to their innovative shooter angling mechanism, this uniqueness of this team’s robot sets it apart. This team made the mold for the Creativity Award. Congratulations, team number 340 Greater Rochester Robotics

The documentation of the robot's design and processes are vital in today's engineering climate. Countless hours of effort are often lost when new team members are forced to "relearn" previously experienced processes and concepts. This team uses a disciplined documentation approach to "cunningly" simplify the design process, and to enhance collaboration among team members. An established detailed documentation process provides a ready library of the team's process and culture for new team members, enabling them to sink their "claws" into easy to understand information. The excellence in Engineering award is proudly awarded to team - 2228 CougerTech

Gracious Professionalism Award After losing a great resource, this team filled a gap. What started as an off-season project has grown to support many. Over one million files strong, this team caches in on some cloud points Congratulations team 8096 Cache Money

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: In a sea of innovation, one teams zest truly gleams. Their creativity and spirit squeeze the essence of dreams. This operation is truly orange, the pick of the grove, the juiciest of teams.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The notes shined bright in this team's atmosphere. Their elegant bot beautifully integrates sensors and machinery and sets the bar high. A toast to the Industrial Design Award recipient. Congratulations Team 4611, Ozone Robotics

Innovation in Control Award Innovative minds soar, control award drives them forward, unique solutions found Competition’s weight eased by state machine’s grace, light sensors guide them. Innovative code, protecting with software’s care, googly eyes watch on, Congratulations team 4150 FRobotics

This team brings together a worldly student body In spite if an unlucky number of committees, they show commitment to the FIRST mission The host, store and help repair robots from around the world. Congratulations team 2638 Rebel Robotics

The quality of this trans wiring and robust design impressed the judges. We were able to hear the melody through the clear intake which harmonized with the rest of the design. This team dovetailed human and robot safety and made the robot ready for War. Congratulations, Team number 4145 the WorBots!

records.teamName: The Giant Diencephalic BrainSTEM Robotics Team
records.script: Competition at FIRST events, both on and off the field, is intense. Teams compete like crazy to triumph on the field, to advance Engineering Impact in their community, or even just to have the longest words in their name. This team helped their community take a FIRST Big Step, more than doubled the average number of our FLL events teams in their community attended, and brought “Robots Without Borders” to an international audience. Congratulations to team 8393, Giant Dicephalic BrainSTEM Robotics Team

The Judges decision did not come easy with all the excellent submissions and presentations this year. The wining team was chosen due to their significant recent successes in spreading the FIRST Mission, directly helping inspire youngsters by devoting thousands of hours on many initiatives including (but not limited to) building and distributing STEM-related kits throughout their state. And after the Pandemic caused their State’s FLL team count to plummet from over 100 teams to near zero, this team seeded seven new teams and undertook the mountainous task of helping grow the State team count to over 50, with more to come. During the Pandemic this team utilized all the digital media tools available to continue their wide outreach, beyond virtual meetings to using videos with accompanying storybooks and narrations, and speedily restarting the world’s only 26 hour robotics endurance event. The FIRST Impact Award goes to Mountaineer Area Robotics, MARS, Team # 2614
Driven to succeed, FTC fuels their passion, programs growing, with sustainable growth. Coffee shop sparks ideas in harmony. The rookie all-star award is presented to 9475
Small team, Dynamic and driven, Student focused. Tiny team at start, Climbing towards crescendo, growing overtime. Congratulations team number 9415

This team builds a professional and joyful team culture, including a diversity of team members in key roles, not just seasoned veterans. Half of this team has never been to a Regional before this weekend, but they acted with poise and enthusiasm through the rigors of competition. This team epitomizes their motto: “better than last year, better than ever.” Congratulations to Team 1787, The Flying Circuits

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: It is a serious challenge to build a robotics program that lasts. This team created a robust sponsorship program and maintain great engagement with key school stakeholders to pull their program out of debt. This team keeps up sustainability practices by recycling and reusing old parts, using rechargeable batteries, and making sure energy is well conserved at the workshop. Lastly, this team holds excellent recruitment and training programs leading to capable students always being “in-reach.” Congratulations to Team 5740, The Trojanators
This teams amazing camera integration was out of this world. Their robot is happy to perform without humans.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This teams creative approach to controlling their robot was impressive! They rock and rolled on the field hitting all the right notes with their guitar controller

With a new build space, these cool cats are building on their extensive pipeline of mentoring FIRST teams at all levels. The judges especially noted their highly effective methods for sharing their work and engineering processes with new team members

This team is certainly not a one team wonder. Partnering with nonprofits and expanding collaborations. Whether it’s sharing meals, volunteering hours, or empowering young engineers, they are excelling is all they take on. They prove time and time again that contrary to their name, they are no ones nemesis
This teams engineering certainly reached a CRESENDO this year. Their detailed and well documented approach was evident throughout their robot. This teams excellence is certainly well “Cultivated”
Displaying extreme gracious behavior even when it might have cost them a match is typical behavior for this these cats

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: From days of yore, they have created an amazing brand that can be seen in all they do. Who knows where their once upon story will take them next

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team embraces function and simplicity with a build matching their strategy. Their hidden belt gathers notes from all sides to make melodies and harmony.
This team integrated cameras into their overall performance. If they were hungry there is lots of orange Pi. Control was easy to see despite the camouflage
The judges were impressed by this teams use of nails and tape to perfect their intake mechanism. Their robot was ‘cruzin’ on the field.
In the world of gears and steel, this teams robot is the real deal. With a low center of gravity and a robust design their excellence is a sight to see
This teams jams both on and off the field. Birds of a feather rock together. Everyone had a “HOOT” listening to their playlist

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is charting a course to the future. They explore every way to maintain and nurture their team knowledge. Their exploration of recycling 3d filament is cool.

records.script: Collecting and scoring food is like an auto function for these CRITTERS. Using Choreo, photon vision and an extremely effective use of P.I.D. loops, this team’s adaptable auto is leading the SCURRY. These furry critters are NUTS about their automation!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Orange adorns this team’s innovative shooter Spinning this way and that, they printed 3D success We rarely SEE TECH this creative from rookie teams

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their color sweeping outreach. With their development of a programming training plan, creating a palette of FTC and FRC teams, starting a Girls FIRST initiative, and advocacy to U.S. Congress, they SPLATTERED their presence far and wide. For this team, their VELOCITY for spreading FIRST values is truly something to run for.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team thinks they are small, but they are actually very mighty. They CLAWED into their learnings and SCRATCHed up a sustainability plan—starting with camps in their community—giving them what it takes to be on a FIRST team. Not only in engineering and programming, but in the arts like pit branding—even designing buttons. The judges believe this rookie team has VIRTUALLY everything they need to BYTE the competition.

This team started by breaking down this year’s game into its key components, and then using the results to guide their engineering strategy. From BLUE to RED, UNDERSTANDING to ITERATING, they have excelled all the way to ELEVEN. When scoring in the amp, this team had a robust AROMA, it was a slam DUNK.

This team is cooking something SAVORY for the judges. Working with their alliance partners, they put all the ingredients together to perfectly concoct a collaborative space for everyone to build and grow their STEAM skills. Order up! Serving their community, the tantalizing success of this team is ready for all to try.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This COOL team impressed the judges, With notes turning blue rain to white SNOW. This team waddles, slips and slides, on and off the ICE.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team is a monster on the field. They have documented every step of their design process and modeled multiple iterations of their bot to create this BEAST. Their robot’s design has come together like a symphony, performing excellently after emerging from HIBERNATION. Listen closely. That deep sound you hear is a BEARitone!
This team’s bot made a real SPLASH with the judges. They made heads SPIN as they drove around the field. This bot JUMPED out of the box with their innovative control.

The Pyramid Award From the top of Mount Olympus to the Pyramids of Giza This team’s passion is helping many international countries start FIRST Teams. This team especially impressed the judges with how they engaged Warp Speed to the sands of Egypt to support the First Robotics teams there

This team kicked off build season by setting a TARGET of a robust, maintainable machine By using clever marking and a modular design for easy maintenance, square plates and steel rivets for durability, and sleek L.E.D.s and paint for attractiveness They really hit the BULLSEYE with the quality of their design
STEM's their passion, igniting minds far and wide. From city to nation, their advocacy moves many. Whether in front of Congress or on the field, this BIRD flies high.

For the elements of the Impact award, this team checks all the boxes. This team uses their advocacy platform to ensure their lawmakers, at all levels, understand why FIRST matters. As you wander through the local museum, make a point to visit the room dedicated to this team's history, struggles and victories. In a museum, you're supposed to be quiet. Shhh!

This team has spent the last two years revitalizing themselves and their FLL community. A core component of their D.E.I. commitment has led to their support of Unified Robotics, and Special Olympics. This team is FORGING their future with FIRST.

This team recognized their community was missing a key ingredient of technical expertise. From releasing their own CAD tools online and easing the learning curve, to hosting a robot CADathon and design challenges, this team made sure their SOUP of knowledge is served up with pride. These MECHANICS certainly raised the bar for everyone to create their technical bowl of Miso.

This team impressed the judges with their courtesy, inclusivity, sense of fun, and dedication to FIRST programs. On the field, you cannot miss them; off the field, you might find them at a team dinner, picnic, or even on JET SKIS. This team is truly BLASTING OFF into the future!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team works to prioritize sustainability within their team and their community. They developed and operated a weekly recycling program where recycling is not widely available. They SPARKED a positive impact in their community and set an example of how we can all work towards sustainability through team involvement.

Cette équipe a su dompter son robot en lui suggérant d’adopter certains comportements très performants Le tout fait avec simplicité et efficacité Tel leur nom d’équipe, malgré l’absence de neige, ils ont su tirer leur robot à travers le terrain hostile. Le prix “Autonomie” est remis à l’équipe 5439, Les Huskies

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Cette équipe a réussi à fusionner le côté analytique et créatif en élaborant leur stratégie de jeu. Ils ont pu nous prouver que les deux hémisphères du cerveau peuvent s’harmoniser pour créer un seul bras robotique multifonctionnel. Le prix de la créativité est remis à l’équipe de Rimouski RIKITIK 3996.

Cette équipe nous a impressionné à plusieurs niveaux sur le plan technique, comme l’intégration avancée de la vision avec des processeurs de pointe, des plans électriques comme nous n’en avons jamais vus, et une chaîne complète de la conception assistée par ordinateur jusqu’à la production automatisée de leur liste de pièces. Elle a porté une grande attention aux détails, résultant en une conception élégante allant jusqu’à protéger leurs caméras avant de laisser leur robot prendre son envol. Le prix de l’excellence en génie est remis à 7605, ASTRO.

Cette équipe prend les autres sous son aile, elle travaille en collaboration avec les autres pour partager les connaissances et les meilleures pratiques. Elle a organisé un tournoi d'exhibition dans leur forteresse. À l'occasion de la nouvelle année lunaire, félicitations au 3975 Les Dragons de Montréal.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: L’image de marque de cette équipe et de son robot a ébloui le jury grâce : - au choix d’une teinte distinctive, exprimant l’amalgame des valeurs, ainsi que des couleurs de FIRST; - à une composition tridimensionnelle riche de sens qui traduit en image le thème et le défi la compétition de robotique “Crescendo”; - et en boni une liste de lecture inspirante qui communique l’élan et la force créatrice de l’équipe! Mesdames et messieurs, c’est avec grand plaisir que le jury remet le “Prix de l’image” à l’équipe 3550 Robotronix !

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Supporter par un excellent processus de conception mécanique et électrique, ils ont su orchestrer une véritable symphonie de contrôle autonome et efficace. Ils ont prouvé de façon ultime qu’ils maîtrisent l’ensemble de conception industriel C’est en concerto que les juges remettent le prix Design Industriel à l’équipe 5528, Ultime AGT

Innover c’est dominer et contrôler c’est triompher. Cette équipe a su pousser l’innovation à chaque mouvement. Cet oiseau gracieux a su survoler le terrain toujours en contrôle. Le prix de l’innovation en systèmes de contrôle est remis à l’équipe 4947 Fenix.

Cette équipe rayonne et fait rayonner sa communauté depuis des années. Leurs tactiques aident de façon fantastiques les passionnés de robotique de l'Estrie. Ils ont évolué et continuerons de le faire. Félicitations à l'équipe 2626 - Évolution pour le prix de juges "rayonnement"

En cette période d’inflation, cette équipe a tout optimisé, des coûts de production à l’usage de leur inventaire de pièces, résultant en un robot de grande qualité. Elle a suivi un processus de conception rigoureux pour produire un robot hyper-propre, hyper-fiable, hyper-bon. Le prix de la qualité est remis cette année à une équipe qui a terminé les matchs de qualification en feu, lançant 5 notes en mode autonome, félicitations à l’équipe 3360, Hyperion.

Le jury félicite cette équipe d’irréductibles, qui par sa détermination et ses stratégies ingénieuses a inspiré et mobilisé toute sa communauté - élèves, familles, partenaires, et mentors - par des activités d’engagement diversifiées et efficaces, qui ont un impact durable, et font rayonner la mission de FIRST et les STIM. C'est avec grande admiration que nous décernons le “Prix de l'Inspiration en Génie” à une équipe qui incarne véritablement le courage et la force du combattant, 3544, les Spatiates.

Cette équipe est pleinement engagée dans FIRST, aidant l'organisation à s'élancer vers le prochain niveau. Nous savons tous que FIRST robotics est "le sport ultime pour le cerveau" , mais cette équipe travaille à ce que ceci devienne une réalité à travers le Québec. Nous avons hâte de voir une bannière du RSEQ rejoindre toutes les autres bannières dans un gymnase dans quelques années. Le gagnant du prix Impact FIRST est l'équipe 3990, Tech for Kids.

Cette équipe recrue a assimilé un nombre impressionnant de concept fort utile en génie. Le haut niveau d'organisation et la DYNAMIQUE de l'équipe est prometteuse pour une longue dynastie. Les gagnants du prix de l'équipe recrue toutes étoiles sont les dynamiques du collège Charles-Lemoyne.

Le nombre de participants de cette équipe est petit, mais ils sont grands en passion, engagement et objectifs. Ils apportent un changement de direction au monde de FIRST pour inclure leurs connaissances du CEGEP. L’équipe gagnante du prix d’inspiration des recrues est 9623, U-turn!

Cette équipe illustre l'esprit d'équipe par ses activités scolaires et communautaires ainsi que par son enthousiasme et son énergie tout au long de ce week-end. Le chant d'équipe de cet androïde peut être entendue tout au long du tournoi ! Felicitations a l’equipe 9102, les Cyborgbulls de la France.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Cette équipe à toutes les compétences pour continuer d’inspirer les génération futures! Ils pensent à la relève, dirige agilement leurs équipe, et implique tous leurs partenaires dans l’atteinte de leurs objectifs. Et reconnaissent l’implication de leurs communautés. Ils partage leurs savoir faire avec les membres recrues. Une alliance entre recrutement et formation leurs permet de soutenir une relève toujours engagée. Leurs vision et leurs travails leurs permettra toujours d’atteindre LEURS OBJECTIFS !! Le prix de durabilite est donner a 5618 - PLS!!

This teams autonomous operations demonstrated efficient and reliable performance during their matches. Their use of sensor feedback for auto aiming, generating trajectories in-game and built-in redundancies made them quick to score, and agile on the field. You may have even seen their custom guitar arm during their fully autonomous amp and speaker shooting.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team sometimes runs like an elegant orchestra at times, while at others like a good garage band ready to rock you out of this world. Using elements that help on and off the field, this team thinks out of the box to deal with world problems and out of this world problems. They would "SHURLEY" love to go on "bike" ride before, during, or after the event.

This team spreads their excitement and passion for engineering in their local community and across the globe. From mentoring every team in their city to hosting various events and programs they made a "splash" in New England. This team didn’t just limit themselves to New England, they strive to inspire others in other continents, shipping robotic materials all the way to Nigeria and regularly collaborating with their friends at the Nigerian school. They are a true example of engineering inspiration.

Discovery, Innovation, Impact, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Fun. These are the Core Values of FIRST. While it is clear that this team has an Impact, they also include the other core values into everything that they do. Discovery-This team has a focus on ensuring that team members are exposed to as many skills as possible, offering a wide variety workshops. Innovation-They have taken an innovate approach to ensuring team sustainability. This team tracks everything so future members understands the history of the team's dynamics. Inclusion-This team knows the importance of starting and mentoring FLL teams and encouraging women to become involved in STEM. They ensure that everyone has the ability to learn about various prominent women in the STEM fields. Teamwork-Led by their Board of Directors, everyone has a place within this team. Coming together to attend and plan their primary outreach events, there is always a way for a student to get involved. Team members also come together to develop new ways to make an impact that also incorporate the team's values, including fundraising for cancer research through sewing. Fun-Sporting their green shirts and straw hats, this team knows how to have a good time. Celebrating team achievements at their Greg-olidays, they strengthen their team bonds and ensure that their team identity comes through to everyone around them.

This team’s engineering solutions took each problem, analyzed it, and put into a practical design. They prototyped their designs to improve their intake and climbing skills. All of their designs “AAARREE” to be contend with.

For this team Gracious Professionalism is not merely a catch phrase; it’s a way of life. It’s about more than just winning; it’s about how you play the game and the manner in which you treat your fellow competitors. Through their actions, this team inspires others, demonstrates exceptional sportsmanship, and enriches the FIRST community with their positive attitude and unwavering dedication.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team is far from cold-blooded, their energy electrified the event! Their aesthetic is iconic, and seamlessly integrated throughout their team on and off the field. They chomp, chomp, chomped up the imagery award!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The industrial design award goes to an elegant green robot with precision in machining and compact design. The robot balanced both form and function. This chained Viper included odometry from swerve drive and 4 note auto path planning.

With great power comes great responsibility. But power is nothing without control. Whether playing notes with a photodiode or raising arms one at a time, this team knows how to harness great power with great control.
This next team finds a rival everywhere they go. With a nearly magical ability to demonstrate excellence in every category, this team didn’t qualify for just one award. Give it up for the BOBS.

We’ve all "heard" that thoughtful design and workmanship make for a successful robot. This machine stomped their way to the top of the hill with its polished appearance, elegant intake, and solid construction. Give it up for the GOAT of quality.

The judges were struck by how this team's spirit soared above the rest, on and off the field. Their extraordinary enthusiasm and spirit is worthy of depiction in any acropolis or pantheon. The fates have spoken...

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team greatly exemplifies sustainability both within their team and community. They worked hard to build their nest and swooped in to clean up the environment. Is it a man, is it a plane, no it's a bird.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: This team rocked autonomous mode by being able to shoot multiple notes into the speaker. They made sure to hit all of the high and low notes, but you definitely won’t hear them on an easy rock station, because they’re all about heavy metal.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Tip your hats off to this team. Using a sprocket tensioner in combination with their 3-D printed chain, their climbing mechanism put them head and shoulders above the competition. This bird of fire team was “smoking” hot.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: This small-town team left a big impression on the judges. They are never done building and promoting FIRST, both literally and figuratively. They inspire us all as they ride off into the sunset.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: This team wowed the judges reaching the community and beyond. They are consistently the winds of change, surging to make FIRST known far and wide. Look out, the storm has arrived and it’s a Category 5!

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: Zoom Zoom! This robot is super-fast. Using a swerve drive for the first year, it was designed for fast cycle times with an in-chassis intake. This robot has no moving parts, but don't call it an underdog. Zoom Zoom Zoomi!

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: The winner of this award wants to keep their name fictional and “burn everything” around them. They challenged each other to respect everyone and committed themselves to helping others succeed, making them truly deserving of this award by exemplifying all the FIRST Core Values.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team came to “rock and roll.” Whether on the field or backstage, this team stays golden. This “flashy” team always found a way to stand out from the crowd.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team stormed in with impressive robot design by incorporating in-take and shooter to their main arm. They were able to effectively manipulate the notes and score from any position on the field. This team is ready to assault the castle.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: Some people keep their robots in the house, some people keep their robots at the office. This team, known for their keen vision and shooting abilities “lights” the victory torch with an ember….and keeps their robot in the garage.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: This team continued to delight the judges with their creativity, outreach, and being an overall good team. With bolts of creativity and sparks of ingenuity, they stitched together a masterpiece of collaboration and innovation through their team connections and fun. Their “electrifying” performance proved they’re the true mad scientists of robotics.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: This team sneaked their way through the competition with a well-built robot by a integrating a number of complex components into a single system. Their robot successfully withstood the challenges of competing against so many quick-moving robots. These villains really know how to build a high-quality robot.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: Don’t let their hungry robot fool you, this rookie team came to win. They are committed to community service and a sustainable vision for the future. This alpha team is paving their way to worlds.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: No “bug” will bring down this team. They are actively transforming the reputation of robotics in their school and community. Give this team a few more years and they will truly be in their “Prime”.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.script: This crew demonstrated flexibility on and off the field. Even when they experienced turbulence, they were the best of wingmen to other crews. They are small, but full of spirit.

records.eventName: PCH District Anderson Event presented by MAGNA
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team’s resilience and dedication keeps them thriving for the long-term. Their blend of perseverance and passion proved that sustainability isn’t just about circuits and gears but about fostering a strong team that never gives up. With their devilishly clever strategies and fiery determination, they proved that when it comes to sustaining success, not even a blue devil can stop them.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team's autonomous program is truly something to behold. Identifying the notes using Limelight and communicating with LEDs, they are able to effectively and efficiently score just by letting the robot do its thing. There really is something magical about a well-programmed auto.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team "climbed" their way to the top with their multi-functional, 4 hook climbing mechanism. The judges were impressed by the efficiency and consistency of this team's original design and in-house fabrication. These devils demonstrated true harmony between the game's challenges and creativity.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team earned this award with their well rounded and exceptional outreach initiatives. Their dedication to finding opportunities for other programs, spreading STEM across underprivileged areas and advocating for STEM funding makes waves across South Carolina. Their efforts blew away the competition and proved to be a true force of nature for inspiring budding young engineers.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team's long term plan, presentation, unwavering commitment to excellence, and community engagement made a lasting impression on the judges. With their passion and enthusiasm, they exemplify the Core Values of FIRST, igniting a passion for STEM in others. This team serves as a "burning" beacon of hope and empowerment, showcasing their ability to make a meaningful impact in the robotics world and beyond.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: The engineering design process demonstrated by this team impressed the judges so much that it could serve as a benchmark for any other teams to strive for. With "wings of inspiration", the "rose" above the rest of the competition and showed how their installation and configuration guide has led them to the success they have achieved.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team is driven to be gracious professionals with multiple outreach events throughout the season as well as all of the support they have provided during this event. Blessing boxes, food drives, first aid kits, and donating parts to teams in need are all part of their team culture that shines brightly. There's no venom present with this large team of gracious professionals!

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: With a cohesive image, this team brought their team spirit alive. From their costumes, to their pits, down to the stitches on their robot, this team really "invigorated" the competition! Their robot made up of parts from previous robots really is a monster in and out of the pits.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team zoomed to the front of the pack with their elegantly designed robot. With a robot that any of us would love to own, even their cogs demonstrate excellent craftsmanship. Don't ever count them out as underdogs.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team caught the judges attention with the use of vision aided shooting. They were "noted" for their consistent ability to score using single button automated alignment and their mastery of utilizing Limelight for detecting the April tags. This definitely helped to "catapult" them and their alliance partners to high scores, proving themselves as a modern day "ballista."

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their adaptability, inclusion of diverse backgrounds and thoughts, and support of other non-STEM initiatives. When things get down "to the wire", this team proves that their robot can run through notes faster than a colony of rabbits can munch carrots.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: The team exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail in their robot's design and construction really elevated them above the competition. Their victory stems from careful planning - included built-in redundancies - conducting thorough system checks, and strategically designing for potential failure points. The quality of their robot leaves the rest of the teams "green with envy."

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This small team of 7 students is a prime example of teamwork. What started as a "Girls-that-Code" club has linked with an electrifying sponsor and grown rapidly into a battle-hardened competitor. This team is an inspiration to all, demonstrating what can be accomplished by a rookie team who just happen to all be best friends.

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team demonstrated a high-flying amount of team spirit in the stands, on the field, and in their pit. Their colorful drive team apparel and energetic mascot kept everyone's spirits soaring. Let's give a "Y - E - L - L" for this team and Eddie the Eagle!

records.eventName: PCH District Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: With their commitment to educating and inspiring younger generations to learn more about STEM, this teams proves that small gains can lead to big rewards. This is a team doing great things in the present but also setting themselves up for success in the future. With their well organized team and sustainability plan, we can rest assured that the "sun will never set" on this team.

Next time around, when they opt for the scenic route to the smoky mountains, they might as well send their robot on a solo adventure. Their robotic buddy, with a mind of its own, kept blasting four musical notes into the speaker and had enough horsepower to make a grand escape across the field.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team climbed to new heights with their cleverly designed shooting mechanism. The robot slid smoothly from its climbing hook to the latching hooks. Their description of both the design and iteration processes meshed together to produce a swinging robot.
This team elevated engineering excellence in two stages. The Judges were left with cascading admiration of their unique method to lift their robot to new heights. They came from just South of us.

This team "blue" the Judges away with all of their work both during and off season. They showed the Judges how they exceeded expectations and overcame perceived limitations. From student mentoring, to hosting off season events, and working with their legislature, they left the Judges asking for an encore!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team and their robot demonstrated a flawless integration of color and appearance. Walking through the dense jungle, the vivid imagery of the vibrant green leaves and a colorful yellow and blue flowers are mesmerizing. Suddenly, a majestic jaguar appears, gracefully prowling by a sloth hanging lazily from a tree branch.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This robot will cause Tony Stark to growl with pride. Who knew there are tigers on Florida's Space Coast?
Seeing only black and white while processing in orange, their robot effortless navigated through the cyber wilderness. The leaders of the tribe have excellent control of their robot.

After losing most of their experienced members, this team developed a design that complemented their capabilities and aspiration. Their simple but elegant design combined functional elements together for effective use on the field of play. The Judges were impressed by their ability to connect design choices, available resources, and long-term goals.

Four notes play loudly gears spin in time Redundant parts sing. Dual inputs drive on Easy to replace and fix Quality assured. Pneumatics hiss strong Custom gears fit perfectly Harmony in motion. Cann of redundancy Dual Inputs for smooth game play Quality prevails. Dual intake inhales Secret hiding in sight Custom swerve, robot.

As in all FIRST programs - advancing, respect, and appreciation of engineering are extremely important. This team took it to a whole other level. Their work with various groups outside of FIRST really spun the Judges for a loop. Despite their name, there is nothing broken or dangerous about this team.

There are a billion reasons this team was selected for the Impact Award. Their program has exploded into a successful STEAM network of FIRST teams across grades K-12. In a relatively short amount of time, they have sparked collegiate and international collaborations. This team generates more electricity than a large power plant.
Even though this team is new and building the airplane as they were flying it, they managed to pilot a functional robot that helped their alliances.

Mach 1 may be the speed of sound, but this team's paper airplanes always seem to surpass it. Engaging team members with enthusiasm can sometimes be like trying to fly a paper airplane in a hurricane. But when everyone is on the same page with a good process, the team can weather any storm.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Recruiting, engaging, and sustaining members was an important objective this year for this team. Spanning their wings to include FLL and FTC, this team is also hawkish about their impact on the environment and financially sustaining their efforts.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow

records.script: They dazzled with their consistent and reliable autonomous performance, navigating the field with precision and executing tasks flawlessly. Their robot's perception, meticulous navigation, and strategic task execution exemplify excellence in autonomous operations. They impressed the judges by running like a kangaroo. Congratulations team 8613 ---- Tutarlı ve güvenilir otonom performanslarıyla hayran bıraktılar, sahada hassas bir şekilde gezindiler ve görevleri kusursuz bir şekilde yerine getirdiler. Robotlarının çevresel farkındalığı,, titiz navigasyonu ve stratejik görev yürütmesi, otonom operasyonlarda mükemmelliği örneklemektedir. Hedeflerine bir kanguru gibi ulaşarak jüriyi etkilediler. Tebrikler takım 8613

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: If we face the sun, we are enlightened and warmed. This vital glow spreads through our body and nourishes our soul. Science is like the sun, if we look at it, we become enlightened and can find solutions to tomorrow's problems. This team combined the power of science with sports, balance and flexibility. This team was also inspired by Cartesian inspiration and focused on solutions. They managed to impress the jury with these solutions. Congratulations, 8561 - Cartesian Robotics ❤️ ----- Güneşe yüzümüzü dönersek aydınlanır ve ısınırız. Bu hayatı ışıltı vücudumuza yayılır ve ruhumuzu besler. Bilimde güneş gibidir, ona bakarsak aydınlanır ve yarınların sorunlarına çözüm bulabiliriz. Bu takım bilimin gücünü sporla birleştirip, denge ve esnekliği bir arada kullandılar. Ayrıca bu takım kartezyen den aldığı ilhamla çözüme kitlendiler. Bu çözümleriyle de jüriyi etkilemeyi başardılar. Tebrik ederiz, 8561 - Cartesian Robotik ❤️

Their engineering skills, which improve every year, have been impressing us for years. This year, with only 4 rollers and an elevator, they impressed us and all the tribunes with their performance in the matches. Their mesmerizing perfection shines in the whitest light of Anatolia. It is in the sultans' genes to pass on this light continuously. Bravo Team 2905 - Sultans of Türkiye. ---- Her sene gelişen mühendislik becerileri bizi yıllardır etkilemeye devam ediyor. Bu sene sadece 4 roller ve bir asansör ile bizi, maçlardaki performansları ile de tüm tribünleri kendilerine hayran bıraktılar. Onların büyüleyici bu mükemmellikleri Anadolu’nun bembeyaz ışığında parlıyor. Bu ışığı sürekli aktarmak sultanların genlerinde var. BravoTakım 2905 - Sultans of Türkiye.

They impressed everyone with their kindness in and out of the pit. They challenged impossibilities with their projects. Let your rocket reach your grace all around the space, launching from the tiny hearts you have touched in village schools. And let this award be a symbol of your sensitive hearts. Congratulations 9024 Callister ----- Oyun sahasının içinde ve dışında nezaketleriyle göz doldurdular. Gerçekleştirdikleri projelerle imkansızlıklara meydan okudular. Köylerde ısıttığınız küçük kalplerden yola çıkan roketiniz, zarafetinizi evrenin her yerine dağıtsın. Bu ödül duyarlı kalplerinizin bir temsili olsun. Tebrikler Takım 9024 Callister

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Rising from the mysterious depths of the sea, a powerful force appears at the heart of the arena! One of the most remarkable teams in robotics, in alignment with FIRST (FRC) principles, turns into an experience that excites all your senses. Our heroes fascinate not only with their technical skills but also with their mascot, inviting spectators to meet a mesmerizing creature. But the real magic starts with the fans in the stands. They surround the team like a sea storm with their costumes, balloons, banners, and other fun materials that reflect the team's image. It is the Kraken itself, not just a team, but a sea lord: Congrats Team 9155 - New Tech Kraken!!!!!! 😊 ---------- Gizemli suların derinliklerinden yükselen bir güç, arenanın kalbinde beliriyor! Robotik dünyasının en dikkat çekici takımlarından biri, FIRST (FRC) ilkelerine sadık kalarak, baş döndürücü bir hızla, tüm duyularınızı zorlayan bir deneyime dönüşüyor. Kahramanlarımız, sadece teknolojik ustalıklarıyla değil, Maskotları, bu heybetli varlığın büyüsünü arenaya taşıyor, izleyicileri büyüleyen bir varlıkla buluşmaya çağırıyor. Fakat asıl büyü, tribündeki destekçilerin yükselen coşkusuyla başlıyor. Onlar, takımın ruhunu yansıtan kostümleri, balonları, pankartları ve diğer birbirinden eğlenceli malzemeleriyle, adeta bir deniz fırtınası gibi, takımın etrafını sarıp sarmalıyorlar. Kim mi bu göz kamaştırıcı ekip? O, sadece bir takım değil, birer deniz efendisi olan Kraken'in ta kendisi: Tebrikler Takım 9155 - New Tech Kraken!!!!!! 😊

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: "The team that won the industrial design award achieved a perfect balance between aesthetics and functionality. In addition to being as strong as iron, they also stood out with their aesthetic sense. Their work will leave a mark in the fields of engineering and design in the future." Congrats Team 6941 ---- “Endüstriyel tasarım ödülünü kazanan ekip, estetik ve işlevsellik arasında mükemmel bir denge sağladı. Demir gibi sağlam olmalarının yanı sıra estetik anlayışlarıyla da öne çıktılar. Yaptıkları çalışma, mühendislik ve tasarım alanlarında gelecekte iz bırakacak." Tebrikler Takım 6941

records.teamName: Our Lady of Providence Dream League
records.script: The team that won this award was aware of control. They managed to control the match with an intake system they specially designed. They came from far away and proved the power of women on the pit with their colorful lights Congrats Team 8806 ----- Bu ödülü alan takım kontrolün kıymetinin farkındaydı. Özel olarak tasarladıkları Intake sistemi ile maçı da kontrol altına almayı başardılar. Çooook uzaklardan gelip ışıl ışıl renkleriyle kadınların gücünü pistte de ispatladılar. Tebrikler takım 8806

The team, attracted the attention of jury with their harmony with each other, copperation dynamics and disciplined stance. They presented us “More Than Robot” both through FIRST values and their projects in engineering and social fields. The team with a French influence, adorned with the nobility of yellow and red and their eye-catching logos, has earned the right to recieve this award. Congratulations! - 9247 SAİNTECH ROBOTICS ---- Takım, birbirleri ile olan uyumu, yardımlaşma dinamikleri ve disiplinli duruşları ile jürinin dikkatini çekmiştir. Gerek FIRST değerleri gerek ise mühendislik ve sosyal alandaki projeleri ile “Bir Robottan Daha Fazlası” mottosunu bizlere sundular. Fransız ekolü olan takım sarı-kırmızının asaleti ve göze çarpan logoları ile bu ödülü almaya hak kazanmışlardır. Tebrikler Takım 9247 Saintech Robotics

This team exemplifies machine robustness from concept to fabrication. Their comprehensive quality plan ensures durability throughout the competition, reflected in the craftsmanship, attachment systems, wiring, and every detail of their machine. Withstood the competition challenges, their design incorporates redundancy and risk mitigation measures, showcasing their commitment to quality. Together, these Blue Magpies, a symbol of peace and teamwork, have unquestionably earned this prestigious award. Congratulations! Team 7632 An Kang Robotics Maker ---- Bu ekip, konseptten imalata kadar makine sağlamlığını temsil ediyor. Kapsamlı kalite planları, işçilik, bağlantı sistemleri, kablolama ve makinelerinin her ayrıntısına yansıyarak yarışma sürecinde dayanıklılık garantisi vermektedir. Rekabetin zorluklarına dayanan tasarımları, kaliteye olan bağlılıklarını gösteren risk azaltma önlemlerini içeriyor. Barış ve ekip çalışmasının sembolü olan bu Mavi Saksağanlar birlikte bu prestijli ödülü almaya hak kazandılar. Tebrikler! Takım 7632 An Kang Robotics Maker

This team made creative and practical projects to spread the importance of STEAM. They also used different branches of art to spread FIRST values and engineering. They reached out to many parts of the world to spread engineering, just like an OCTOPUS. Congrats, Team 4191, IMC ---- Bu takım, STAEM'in önemini yaymak için yaratıcı ve etkili projeler yaptı. FIRST'ün değerlerini ve mühendisliği yaymak için sanatın farklı dallarından da faydalandı. Mühendisliği yaymak için dünyanın çok farklı noktalarına, tıpkı bir AHTAPOT gibi uzandı. Tebrikler, 4191, IMC

This team has energized its members to develop quite innovative projects. These projects included apps, kits to teach children mechanics, and use of artificial intelligence to assist other teams. 2023-2024 season their impact reached a crescendo. This is a team that makes meeting a dragon a real inspiration… Congrats 6014 ARC ---- Bu takım üyelerini oldukça yenilikçi projeler geliştirme konusunda harekete geçirdi. Bu projelerin arasında app geliştirme, çocuklara mekanik öğreten setler ve diğer takımlara yardımcı olacak yapay zeka uygulaması da var. 2023-2024 sezonunda etkileri bir zirve yaptı. Bu takım bir ejderha ile karşılaşmayı gerçek bir ilham kaynağı yapar… Tebrikler 6014 ARC

Team members with various characteristics from different countries have formed their teams by internalizing the FIRST values with solid motivation. Their motto is “Stronger Together” and called themselves “Ladybugs”. Congratulations Team 9647 ---- Farklı ülkelerden farklı özelliklere sahip ekip üyeleri, güçlü bir motivasyonla FIRST değerlerini içselleştirerek ekiplerini oluşturdular. Sloganları “Birlikte Daha Güçlüyüz” ve kendilerine “Uğur Böceği” adını verdiler. Tebrikler Takım 9647

Declaring their independence, this rookie team comes together with unity becomes strength idea. They pushed all limits to get here. The white robots, who impressed the jury and showed they could carry the FRC spirit forward with their determination and bolts, fully deserved this award. Congratulations, 9440. ----- Bağımsızlıklarını ilan eden bu rookie takım, birlikten kuvvet doğar bilinci ile birleşti. Buraya gelebilmek için tüm sınırları zorladılar. Jüriyi etkileyerek FRC ruhunu azimleri ve cıvataları ile ileri taşıyabileceklerini gösteren beyaz robotlar, bu ödülü sonuna kadar hak etti. Tebrikler, 9440.

This team managed to impress the jury with their excitement and enthusiasm as a whole. Red Panthers worked collaboratively, increasing motivation in the face of difficulties. Congratulations; 9231. ----- Kendilerini çevrelerine duyuran bu takım birlik olarak heyecanları ve coşkuları ile jüriyi etkilemeyi başardı. Kırmızı panterler; Zorluklar karşısında motivasyonlarını arttırarak işbirliği içinde çalıştılar. Tebrikler; 9231.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: The winning team worked hard to ensure that the FIRST spirit and values were sustainable through projects and studies. Especially a social responsibility mindset, strong solidarity, and cooperation within the team, setting the team as a first, Designing and producing using recycled materials, and we know them with their water-green sweatshirts. Congrats Team - 8264 ----- Kazanan takım, yaptıkları projeler ve çalışmalarla FIRST ruhunun ve değerlerinin sürdürülebilir olmasını sağlamak için var gücüyle çalışmıştır. Özellikle, ⁠Sosyal sorumluluk anlayışı, Takım içi güçlü dayanışma ve iş birliği, Takım varlığını önde tutma , Geri dönüşümlü malzeme kullanımları ile dizayn ve üretim becerileri ile dikkat çektirler. Ve biz onları su yeşili sweatshirtleri ile tanıyoruz. Tebrikler Takım 8264

They were outstanding at the beginning of the match. Successfully scanning their surroundings, they fulfilled their tasks one by one. They shone like a torch and reminded everyone that robots can have hearts too. Congratulations, Team 8054 Flare Robotics ---- Maç başlarında olağanüstü performans sergilediler. Çevresini başarılı bir şekilde tarayarak, görevlerini birer birer yerine getirdiler. Bir meşale gibi parladılar ve herkese robotların da kalbi olabileceğini hatırlattılar. Tebrikler Takım 8054

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.teamName: Our Lady of Providence Dream League
records.script: In the challenge where thinking outside the box makes all the difference, a team has stood out. Their fresh ideas didn't just solve problems, they showed us all the awesome stuff women in engineering can do when they roll up their sleeves and get to work. They've shown us that creativity isn't about doing what's always been done, but about trailblazing new ways. They have been an encouragement and a guidance to all the women out there dreaming of gears and tools. So hats off to this team. Congratulations team #8806 Our Lady of Providence Dream League --- Alışılmışın dışında düşünmenin büyük fark yarattığı bu mücadelede bir ekip öne çıktı. Yeni fikirleri sadece sorunları çözmekle kalmadı, aynı zamanda mühendislik alanında çalışan kadınların kolları sıvayıp işe koyulduklarında ne kadar harika şeyler yapabileceklerini de gösterdi. Bize yaratıcılığin her zaman yapılanı yapmakla değil, yeni yollara öncülük etmekle ilgili olduğunu gösterdiler. Dışarıda dişlilerin ve aletlerin hayalini kuran tüm kadınlara bir teşvik ve yol gösterici oldular. Bu yüzden bu ekibe şapka çıkarıyoruz. Tebrikler takım #8806 Our Lady of Providence Dream League

This team has set a benchmark in robot design for lightness and durability by efficiently using carbon fiber construction materials. Their custom-designed gear mechanism not only showcases their engineering expertise but also significantly enhances the performance of their robots. They have brought their robots from the Far East to our country, breathing life into metal. Congratulations Team 6941, Ironpulse! ---- Bu takım, robot tasarımında hafiflik ve dayanıklılıkta bir ölçüt belirleyerek, karbon fiber yapı malzemelerini verimli bir şekilde kullanmıştır.
