Kendi tasarladıkları dişli çark mekanizması, sadece mühendislikteki ustalıklarını sergilemekle kalmamış, aynı zamanda robotlarının performansını önemli ölçüde artırmıştır. Onlar ülkemize uzak doğudan getirdikleri robotları ile metale can verdiler. Tebrikler, takım 6941 Ironpulse.

The team that received this award demonstrated the importance of gracious professionalism while spreading FIRST values. They ensured that everyone, regardless of age, has access to the education they need and shared their knowledge, equipment and budgets with other FRC and FLL teams. You can recognise them by their red checked pyjamas in the stands and pit area. Congratulations, #8795 The Chaotics! ---- Bu ödülü alan takım, FIRST değerlerini yayarken duyarlı profesyonelliğin önemini de ortaya koydu. Hem yaş farkı gözetmeden herkesin ihtiyacı olan eğitime ulaşabilmesini sağladı hem de diğer FRC ve FLL takımlarıyla bilgi, donanım ve bütçelerini paylaştı. Onları tribün ve pit alanındaki kırmızı kareli pijamalarından tanıyabilirsiniz. Tebrikler, #8795 The Chaotics!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team takes you to a world of wonders through their storied projects and warrior heroes. Environmentally conscious, not forgetting anyone on nature, carry the FIRST spirit to the next generation - that’s their purpose. Is there such a thing as a peaceful warrior? They say “why not?” and take us along with their Viking spirit. Congratulations team 9043 ---- Bu takım hikayeleşmiş projeleri ve savaşçı kahramanları ile harika bir dünyaya götürüyorlar sizi. Çevreye duyarlı, doğada kimseyi unutmayan, yeni nesile FIRST ruhunu taşımayı kendilerine amaç edindiler. Barışçıl savaşçı olunur mu? Neden olmasın diyip bizi Vikingler ruhuna taşıdılar. Tebrikler takım 9043

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team, with their monoblock chassis made from CNC machined lightweight aluminum, has perfectly balanced the durability and lightness of their robots, as if they came straight out of mass production, gaining an advantage on the field and making a difference. They come from the land of kangaroos, Australia. Congratulations, team 4613 Red Backs! ---- Bu takım, CNC işlemeli hafif alüminyum malzemeden yapılmış mono blok şaseleri ile seri üretimden çıkmışçasına robotlarının hem dayanıklılığını hem de hafifliğini mükemmel bir şekilde dengeleyerek, sahada avantaj sağlamış ve fark yaratmışlardır. Onlar kanguru diyarı Avustralya'dan geliyor. Tebrikler, takım 4613 Red Backs

They combined Electrical, Mechanical and Software with the most innovative control systems. With multiple sensors on their robots, they were able to scan the field at any time with the agility of a cat. It all started with the 'Snowball effect'. Congrats team 9483 Istanbul WildCats. --- Elektrik, Mekanik ve Yazılımı en yenilikçi kontrol sistemleriyle birleştirdiler. Robotlarındaki çoklu sensörlerle sahayı bir kedi çevikliğiyle her an taramayı başardırlar. Herşey ‘Kartopu efekti’ ile başladı. Tebrikler takım 9483 İstanbul WildCats.

Their impressive strategies and innovative solutions on the field have demonstrated that they possess not only knowledge and skill in the robotics field but also creativity and team spirit. This team from the land of spicy cuisine has stood out not only for their technical excellence but also for their ability to work together as a team and overcome challenges. Congratulations 8570 Binary-Bolts! --- Sahada sergiledikleri etkileyici stratejiler ve yenilikçi çözümler, onların robotik alanında sadece bilgi ve beceriye değil, aynı zamanda yaratıcılığa ve takım ruhuna da sahip olduğunu göstermiştir. Baharatlı yemeklerin ülkesinden gelen bu ekip, teknik mükemmelliklerinin yanı sıra, takım olarak bir arada çalışma ve zorlukların üstesinden gelme yetenekleriyle de öne çıkmıştır. Tebrikler 8570 Binary-Bolts

The work of this team remains mysterious, with colors that reflect the deep passion of red and the resolute strength of black. Each link and gear system is a masterpiece of engineering ingenuity, shining in its durability and performance on the competition field. Like a web woven with quality and passion, this team went beyond the ordinary at every stage of the competition to be recognised with this award. Congratulations, team 6459 AG ROBOTIK! ----- Bu takımın eseri, kırmızının derin tutkusu ve siyahın kararlı gücünü yansıtan renklerle gizemini koruyor. Her bir bağlantı ve dişli sistemi, mühendislik ustalığının bir şaheseri olarak, yarışma alanındaki dayanıklılığı ve performansıyla parlıyor. Kalite ve tutkuyla örülmüş bir ağ gibi bu ekip, rekabetin her aşamasında sıradanlığın ötesine geçerek bu ödülü almaya layık görülmüştür. Tebrikler, takım 6459 AG ROBOTIK!

This team tries to spread the FIRST spirit through their respect for engineering. Their successful use of engineering in projects for change, health care and easy life, caught the attention of the jury. We see the blue cougars, who inspire many students with their commitment to education, at the FRC with their beautiful energy Congratulations 6988 ---- Bu takım, mühendisliğe duydukları saygı ile FIRST ruhunu yaymaya çalışıyor. Sağlık, değişim ve hayatı kolaylaştırmak için yaptıkları projelerde mühendisliği başarılı bir şekilde kullanarak jürinin dikkatini çekti. Eğitime verdikleri önem ile çok sayıda öğrenciye ilham veren mavi pumaları; güzel enerjileri ile FRC’de görüyoruz Tebrikler 6988

The FIRST spirit requires us to unleash the courage to challenge conventions and the consciousness to redefine the limits of possibility. When we take the initiative to achieve this, we refuse to be passive observers of our own lives. Instead, we become active participants in shaping our destiny and influencing the course of events. By highlighting these values, the winning team managed to spread the FIRST spirit more widely. By blending all these values with the concepts of technology and peace, they made us experience the FIRST spirit. ---- FIRST ruhu geleneklere meydan okuyacak cesareti ve olasılıkların sınırlarını yeniden tanımlayacak bilinci açığa çıkarmamızı gerektiriyor. Bunu sağlamak için inisiyatif aldığımızda kendi hayatlarımızın pasif gözlemcileri olmayı reddederiz. Bunun yerine, kaderimizi şekillendiren ve olayların gidişatını etkileyen aktif katılımcılar haline geliriz. Kazanan takım bu değerleri daha ön plana çıkararak FIRST ruhunu etki alanına daha çok yaymayı başarmıştır. Tüm bu değerler ile teknoloji ve barış kavramlarını harmanlayarak FIRST ruhunu bize yaşattılar.

This team has internalised the FIRST spirit in the first year with their projects. Even though they are a new team, they has shared their possibilities with other teams with the understanding that less is more. This year's award goes to the team with ivy, which has a workshop in the car park. Congratulations! Team 9610 Blue Ivy! --- Bu takım yaptıkları projeler ile FIRST ruhunu ilk yılda içselleştirmiştir. Yeni bir takım olsalar da, az çoktur anlayışı ile elindeki imkanları diğer takımlar ile paylaşmışlar. Bu yılki ödülümüz otoparkta atölyesi bulunan sarmaşıklı takıma gitmektedir. Tebrikler! Takım 9610 Blue Ivy!

eing a rookie is hard, being an inspiration to rookies is even harder. In their rookie year, this team did countless projects, trainings and even founded robotic solutions for the environmental sustainability. They spread the FIRST spirit in harmony with their members from all over the world, floated their robots on rivers, insipired us all. Congratulations Team #9647 Lady Bug ---- Rookie olmak zor, rookielere ilham olmak daha zordur. Bu takım rookie senesinde sayısız proje, eğitim ve hatta çevre için robotik çözümler üretti. Onlar, dünyanın her yerine yayılmış üyeleriyle ahenk içinde FIRST ruhunu yaydı, robotlarını nehirlerde yüzdürdü, hepimize ilham verdiler. Tebrikler Takım #9647 Lady Bug

An experienced team, pushing the young one to the front, everyone taking their turn to do what they do best. Over the years, they’ve collected a lot of treasure but instead of hoarding it they share it freely. And their symbol, the dragon in the colour of equality. Congrats Team 6014 ARC ---- Deneyimli gençlerin sahnenin önüne iten, cesaretlendiren herkesin en iyi olduğu işi yaptığı bir takım. Yıllar boyunca pek çok değer elde etmiştir, fakat bu değerlerin saklamak yerine başkalarıyla paylaşmış. Bu takımın sembolü, aynı zamanda eşitliği simgeleyen renkteki ejderhadır. Tebrikler takım 6014 ARC

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has worked to ensure that the FIRST’s spirit and values spread and continue forever with the projects and studies they have carried out. As a requirement of the principle of sustainability, they supports newly established or to be established FRC teams in order to transform the gains it has achieved in the past into equal opportunities. This year's award-winning team who adopt the principle of growing FIRST by sharing their gains with the spirit of "Pay It Forward”, is known as green dragons. Congratulations #5665 Sparc! ---- Bu takım yaptıkları projeler ve çalışmalarla FIRST ruhunun ve değerlerinin yayılmasını ve sonsuza dek devam etmesini sağlamak için çalışmıştır. Sürdürülebilirlik ilkesinin gereği olarak, geçmişte elde ettiği kazanımları fırsat eşitliğine dönüştürmek için yeni kurulan veya kurulacak olan FRC takımlarının yanındadır. Bu yılki ödül kazanan takımımız "Pay It Forward” ruhuyla kazanımlarını paylaşarak FIRST’ü büyütmeye ilke edinen yeşil ejderhalar. Tebrikler ! #5665 Sparc!

Relying on their robust code at the start of matches, they attacked right into the notes. They were so confident in what their robots would do that they didn't hesitate to push the boundaries. With their sharp eyes, environmental awareness and precise navigation, they excelled in their autonomous missions. “Wilds” of carpets, “Cats” of Istanbul.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team combines their creative and technical skills to make a significant impact in the robotics world. Along their long journey, they adorn their modular robots with components designed by generative artificial intelligence, featuring an extraterrestrial aesthetic, offering a unique perspective to the FRC scene. We commend their innovative spirit and inspiring efforts, embodied in their robots named after the legendary William Tell.

Their systematic approach, their analysis and documentation of their work fascinate even professional engineers and enable them to achieve their dreams in a short time. They fully reflected their slogan “Improvise - Adapt - Overcome” in their design. They introduced Bot-Thoven's Sonata to us from India.

This team extends their courtesies and support to different countries beyond the borders of their own, enabling less fortunate communities to elevate to equal opportunities through their projects, and finally, sharing all their energy from one end of the Silk Road to the other, reaching the Marmara Regional with us!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: They won our hearts not only with their collaborations and technological achievements, but also with their creative ideas, aesthetic sense and the warm and positive energy they create in the pit area. May their little cat in their logo bring them luck.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team's robot boasts a meticulously thought-out and calculated design. Every detail is carefully planned and executed. Robot showcasing not only aesthetic appeal but also impressive functionality with a shooting mechanism where 8 parts are welded together.

"This team stands out with innovative control techniques and strategies. The team has made significant progress by employing unique and effective solutions in the control systems of their robots. Their successful control applications, enhanced by the excellent harmony of sensors and colorful feedback lights, from purple to green, establish them as pioneers in this field within FRC.

This team impressed the jury with their projects in various fields reflecting the principles of FIRST. Their team spirit, internal harmony, discipline, and collaboration dynamics go beyond just building a robot, showcasing the motto of "more than a robot." Representing strength, the "Green Dragons" rightfully earned this special award

The robot of this team stand out on the playground, thanks to their meticulous craftsmanship and unwavering durability. From thoughtful design to impeccable execution, these machines serve as a testament to the team's dedication to quality. Behold with their parrot and let their torch enlighten your way. With robustness guided by their efforts, they've proven their mettle time and again.

This team caught the attention of the judges with their discipline, sustainable goals, and projects carried out with high initiative. They transcended boundaries by eliminating language barriers to increase both STEAM and FIRST impact. They built their stands like fortresses, reflecting the spirits of their names.

This team is behind workshop programs designed to bridge the digital divide for underprivileged youth. Their dedication to promoting inclusion and accessibility for visually impaired is truly commendable. Through partnerships with NGOs, they've empowered countless children. We are inspired by their passion, dedication and the fire in their eyes, and we are confident that their efforts will continue to make a positive difference in the lives of many. We hope to see more robots that find their hearts and invisible bonds to increase their impact on society!

Instead of becoming ineffective, they created areas of change in their own regions with interactive reactive approaches. By sharing their work with everyone, both themselves and their influence have grown. Their name may mean to destroy, but their choices displayed the opposite.

This year, our newly established team is dedicated to improving itself and spreading the FIRST spirit. They have attracted the attention of the jury with the establishment of Turkey's first children's association. Congratulations to the team that smells like lavenders!

This team impressed judges with their high motivation and cooperation. They revived team spirit on an unknown planet from the depths of space. They managed to bring this spirit to FRC with their purple dragons

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: With their projects, they worked hard to ensure the sustainability of FIRST spirit and values. Despite coming from different schools, they gave us all hope for a sustainable future with their projects that ensured the continuity of the team. They are the shining stars of Haliç, the pearl of Istanbul...
Their show-stopping autonomous program had the judges on the edge of their seats. Not 1- not 2 - not 3 but 4 notes! What!?! Way to go team 4206 Robot Bikes from Ft Worth Tx

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team was no calico kitten. They leveled up their training and established a new high score for creativity. Connecting their controllers to the world of gaming put them paws above the competition. Congratulations team 7125 Tigerbotics

This team works ceaselessly to inspire the next generation of STEM leaders, As they hop from Team Mentoring to Robo Camps,They constantly nibble at their goals of teamwork, dedication, passion and fun.Lettuce introduce our Engineering Inspiration winner 4063, TriKzR4Kidz, Del Rio TX

This team applies what they have learned in FIRST to improve their community and the world. They have planted their flag - actually over 10,000 flags - in their STEAM field. Their outreach efforts have resulted in 90 new FIRST students this year and impacted even more world wide. Join us in congratulating Team 6369 Mercenary Robotics from McKinney, Texas

This team protects many initiates under their wings with a high-flying scouting program. Their razor-sharp focus helps them soar above the rest. Their impressive design along with “Lego your Lego” earned this team the Excellence in Engineering Award. Congratulations, 5411, RoboTalons

This team stood out with their community-building efforts by spreading cheer through personalized messages and sweet rewards. This outstanding display of sportsmanship and kindness Embodies Gracious Professionalism. They were truly "Z" best. Congratulations Zia Robotics

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team sparkled with a unique and regal aesthetic that enchanted all who beheld it. Sporting purple hues, this team reigned supreme in visual excellence, capturing the essence of the competition's Imagery award. With a touch of royal flair and donning tiaras, congratulations team 9492, Lady Talons!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Where did you come from, where did you go? They brought their best bot to the show. Quick draw PID puts their target in sight. They are the team left standing in the Industrial Design Fight. Congratulations, Team 1164, Project NEO

This team showcased “pawsitively” cutting-edge control innovations setting them apart from the rest. Sporting distinctive blue camo, they drove the competition wild with their 4-point auto feature and highly automated robot design, making it a "purr-fect" choice for the "Innovation in Control" award. Congratulations Team 4192, Jaguar Robotics!

Even when this team bites off more than they can chew, they found a unique way to make it through. Their sweet treats keep them strong when the stress is on. They bend, but don’t break, and they shed their headaches like a snake. Congratulations team 9137 Bionic Vipers

Can you hear me Batman? I know you can. This team has placed a dazzling selection of challenges and puzzles within Crescendo, but I, Edward Nigma have found high quality protoges who are up to the task. Congratulations team 9080, Enigma

In the heart of the competition, this Rookie team defied expectations with their coding and building skills, rivaling those of seasoned veterans. Surprisingly, only one member had prior experience with FIRST before this year! Congratulations Team 9620 Eltynien from Montezuma, NM

In a whirlwind of gear-turning and bolt-tightening, this rookie team spun heads by tweaking their design with each iteration, even adding a 'net' profit feature! Proving they were no 'soft-ware' rookies, morphing Anna into a defensive powerhouse and netting themselves the Rookie Inspiration Award. Congratulations team 9457 Matronic Circuits

Sporting green and black colors, this team had the crowd roaring in support, showcasing a team spirit that was truly electrifying and earning them the Team Spirit award. This team brought a tornado of energy and unity, creating a burst of excitement that swept through the event. Congratulations Rampage, Team 9136!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: In an electrifying display of forward-thinking and perseverance, this team detonated their commitment to creating a lasting-legacy in robotics, aiming to "bomb" everyone with their sustainable spirit.Advocating for FIRST Robotics at the legislative level and educating lawmakers about the program, their explosive efforts earned them the prestigious Sustainability Award, Congratulations team 4153, Project Y's

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team has an “I Can” do attitude. Their program consistently hits the target, scoring in all positions. It CANNOT do any better.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This hoard plunders the field. As in a longship, weight is critical. Thus using compartments versus solid wood, sort of like cardboard. This team reduced the weight of their bot like the Vikings of old.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: The team we are recognizing today dances thru every barrier in their path. They continue to grow as they forge alliances to encourage and support others to join the FIRST community.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team's impact is felt around the world. They are stars at evolving their outreach and finding new ways to elevate other teams and their community. The results of their work reach to infinity and beyond!

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: It takes a lot of energy to build a robot. Their effort can fill many notebooks, but that’s what makes this team our heroes.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team welcomes all with bits of joy and support. They opened their doors to all commers and helped those in need. They truly represent a winning hand, raking in the chips.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: As the yellow sun brightens the sky, This robot flies through the stage and stands, Its colors lifting our spirits on the wings of a bird.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team has both magnitude and direction. Their distinguished bot is both elegant and sleek. Their bearing is plotting a course toward success.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team was not satisfied to include a limelight navigation swerve on their robot. So they developed a pair of higher speed vision processors… to give their robot eyes of a metal raptor.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: After learning how to overcome. This team used their VOICE to lift others to the stage. They amplified their impact many times more than three.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team keeps their pit organized and clean. Their wines are labeled and harnessed. Loose screws or a missing wrench are not going to short their electrical!

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team is an early and strong advocate for FIRST. Whether serving notes on the field or candy in school, scoring points for their team is their ultimate goal.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team rode the bus to competition today. Then they inspired us all as they channeled their fury on the field.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: Everyone on the stage has heard this team today. From yelling and cheering to a Bright Silver Bot. This team is always ready to TANGO!

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Rather than let it go to waste, This scrappy team helped their sponsor cleanup. Fanning the flames of a royal future in FIRST.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team served a tasty dish to the judges, embodying the Rookie All Star award with their commitment to technical excellence and quality outreach. Their self-published children’s book adds a flavor of STEM education to the shelves of their local libraries. From their FTC-sized swerve to their outreach to students with special needs, this alumni-founded team has more layers than a lasagna.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: With all the energy of a bucking bronco, this team is charging forward through their community, reaching new students through their collaboration and outreach efforts. They are so committed to FIRST that, as an FTC team, they missed school last year to introduce new members to the FRC program at World Championships. They are shooting for the STARS with their specialized learning programs, helping their students earn certifications in a wide variety of software.

This team is seen reaching out within their local community in elementary schools, at parades, and at athletic events, inspiring future engineers year round. This team chooses their involvement wisely and with their EYES wide open. They host FIRST events, start FTC teams, produce in house parts for camps, and have extended their reach globally. This team soars above all others, mentoring 100 special ed athletes in the last 3 years with 40 this year alone in all aspects of STEAM.

This team methodically inspires future engineers working across FIRST programs from FLL to FTC to FRC, creating a pipeline of FIRST-ers. This team campaigns for STEM education by hosting STEM camps and giving STEM presentations to kids of all ages, emphasizing GIRLS CAN be future engineers. This team makes it loud - just listen for the boom on Friday nights in the Valley.

Dreams come true when this team helps young children discover their passion for STEM. They go above and beyond making an impact. This team sponsors events supporting the future pioneers of the future. They challenge elementary school children with engineering design program. Boundaries don’t stop this team from spreading their love of FIRST. This team has changed the lives of many teams around the world. They inspire EVERY day, EVERY where and EVERY one with their Everybot.

This team spreads the FIRST Mission by being the Champions of the FIRST Core Values, making FIRST accessible and inclusive of all students no matter their background or financial resources. With multiple initiatives, they impact the FIRST community by sharing scouting data and mentoring rookies beyond the boundaries of Texas. They inspire and nurture the future of STEM by promoting FIRST for all elementary schools in the district and providing one-on-one mentoring to students with disabilities. Come Ko-pilot with these Super Heroes on Tik Tok. We certainly would all APPRECIATE it.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team did an excellent job with robot pose localization and auto aiming. They created a variety of autos that accurately follow the paths, allow auto aiming of the shooter and drivetrain. Their mini pc helped with the vision processing to see through the HAZE.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team identified an intake complexity and aimed for a creative solution. This solution simplified the amount of moving parts while reducing weight and maximizing resources. One motor and 41 chain links are all it takes.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: To engineer is to identify the problems and solve them. This applies to every stage of development. This team embraces modern engineering processes and their ancient origins. their bot marks the cadence in this season.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: Core Values are taught to younger teams to help harmonize the community. This team inspires a passion for STEM by lending a helping hand whether you are two or eighty. You can’t hide their pride as lavender lights flare when they come into town. WHAT TIME IS IT?

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: These students bring the sparkle and shine to spring them into a crescendo in a concert. Aiming for the stars is a CONSTANT sea of blue in the pit, robot, and uniform.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Design is more than aesthetics, it also has to solve different aspects of the challenge with a key component in the human players themselves. This team’s bot design boasts an elegant, compact, yet multifunctional design. Their bot shines when controlled by the super power couple of the Nintendo world.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team went for it and set their vision on the stars. Drawing inspiration from past FIRST World Championships, they went beyond the mechanics and looked to AI to level up their control. Just like a twister, they are a force to be reckoned with.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: Charging forward, this team works with a diverse group to promote STEM to all students. Using class time, students mentor each other to learn CAD and programming online so that all students can participate. Building robots and breaking down barriers, this team takes pride in their LGBTQIA+ shirts.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: Anyone can see the quality of both this team and their robot. Everything from the design to the wiring is clean and robust. When this team gets down to work, whether manufacturing or repair, there’s no duct tape in sight.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: Thanks to a comprehensive five year plan, this team is guaranteed to be a pillar of their community for generations to come. With crowns held high, this young team is breaking barriers in STEM education. Like a phoenix rising from the ashes, they “Fight Like a Girl” to ensure that all women feel welcomed and empowered in STEM.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: Working with sponsors, this team flies high with spirit in the community and in the stands. Using their talons to hold their spirit signs, you can’t miss their enthusiasm. This team rises to the vertical challenge cheering for three times the teams.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Being a community team, this group builds relationships by outreaching to multiple school districts to create their team. STEM Camps lead the way to spreading STEM to elementary schools to teach Core Values and Gracious Professionalism. Working the FIRST program, they unite FLL, FTC, and FRC making this team an excellent choice for sustainability.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: This team has a very distinctive color. However, its auto scoring is so fast that it will leave you seeing colored lights. In the end, only purple remains.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team doesn’t just plow through design iterations - they want stable performance. They have an overall plan for innovation, and a whole crop of new ideas. From their flamingo hooks on their custom actuated space-grade hang arms to their powder painted wheels, this team impressed the judges with a whole basket full of FRESH creativity.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: This team’s secret sauce had three main ingredients: brainstorming many ideas, building many iterations and prototypes, and quality failure analysis. After spending some time in their pit, the judges realized why they smoked the competition.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: Here is a team that is far from poached. This team shares their practice field, provides robot inspections, and teaches grant writing tips. With programs like Brilliant Black Builders, Safe Place for STEM, and Princesses with Power Tools, they exhibit gracious professionalism with PEARfection.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s cohesive and captivating visual aesthetic, from the high seas to the competition arena, truly set them apart. The "Arrr"-mazing imagery designed by this team made waves with their aquatic mascot and swashbuckling theme. From their net covered pit to their treasure map of team members, nothing escaped these pirates’ keen eyes.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team developed their robot like a professional company. This bot’s elegant design and black coloring blends nicely throughout form and function. The design process is worth its weight in gold.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: This team’s innovations weren’t only practical, they blew the competition away! Their black box of data during matches allowed them to fine tune their automatic handling of notes in every part of their robot. Using their custom parthin program, they showed that their robot is a Maestro on the field that could even compete against Superman.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: In a competition where innovation reigns supreme, there's a team that stands tall like mighty warriors in the realm of safety and engineering! Their safety plan was as solid as a shield forged in the fires of Valhalla, providing a fortress of protection for all. With their QR-coded incident reporting system, meticulous accident tracking, and robust safety failure analysis, they navigated through challenges like seasoned sailors on the high seas.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: As the sun sets, casting an orange glow over the horizon, the ground trembles with the thunderous roar of gears grinding and metal clanking. A might machine emerges, ready to conquer all in its path. This robust robot is built like a tank!

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: Galloping into the spotlight as a beacon of rookie inspiration, this team's ability to engage their community with engineering is truly unmatched. This team broke the gate with their initiative to create a robotics club, opening the doors for all students in their school to participate in FRC and igniting a passion for STEM among their peers. By expanding accessibility to robotics in their school they’ve ensured a bright future for their robotics team.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: When it comes to electrifying the atmosphere with enthusiasm and unity, this team certainly knows how to tighten the bolts and rev up the crowd. Their unwavering cheers and support for ALL teams showcased true sportsmanship and camaraderie. Sporting purple capes and sparkly cowboy hats, their enthusiastic support for all teams created a vibrant and inclusive atmosphere that uplifted everyone.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: In the fierce jungle of competition, this team emerges victorious with a purr-fectly sustainable strategy that sets them apart. Mentoring dozens of FLL and FTC teams, advocating for STEM education on a national level, and cohosting off-season events, they pave the way for a future where innovation flourishes. This blue camouflaged team isn't just blending in - they're roaring ahead with a solid future thanks to their efforts in sustainability and investment in STEM in their community.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation

Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
