records.script: TURN IT UP TO ELEVEN! This team’s performance in the autonomous period was big, loud and super effective. Though they can easily shoot for the stars, their robot proves time and again that it can reliably launch notes on its own over and over again. An astronomical explorer truly goes automatic.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Searching the depths for new ideas, this team designed a unique hook mechanism, which managed to hang their robot on the chain over and over again, and they never made their alliance partners walk the plank right off the stage. Floating at the top of the waves of competition, their robot was a swashbuckling warrior!
This team’s commitment to STEAM outreach shines brighter than ever. From Blackout to neon bright, they illuminated enthusiasm in their community.

If you could bottle and sell this team’s energy and enthusiasm for outreach, Jeff Bezos would be a regular at team meetings. They are happy to talk about all the teams they started, the inclusive events, the literally thousands of hours mentoring and volunteering. Dressing up and handing out treats, this team has grown into a recruitment machine. Winter, Spring, Summer and Fall, this team has done it all. Want to hear more? Prepear(adox) yourself for a huge time commitment.

From a deliberate process to make sure that they stick the chain lift, to evaluating the perfect pitch on their intake, this team has blown the judges away with their engineering design and development. Escaping the whirlpool of design options, this team, patiently worked through controlled changes, and they paid off for this whirlwind of a team.

The judges were very impressed with this team’s efforts to help lift up other teams and bring them back to success in FIRST. Their signature powder blues were everywhere in the pits as well. Count it down - 3…2…1…DANCE!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: From the murky depths of who-knows-where, this team's image went deep into the depths in form, function, and aesthetics. You might be reeled in with their bright colors, hats, but never fear -they will keep their eye on you. Is it a shark? Is it a whale? No! It's … something else…

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Shine a spotlight on this team’s design process that utilizes iterative design processes that lead to effective gameplay on the field. Turn the prism again, and you see the colorful balance in a new light – a beautiful machine that is ready for it’s star turn on the stage!

Look out! This rookie team has their foot on the accelerator and is ready to TAKE OFF! They harnessed the power of a fresh idea to develop a pivotal concept for floor pickup and elegant, accurate shooting. Like a powerful engine, this robot delivered maximum performance from a minimalist footprint.

What happens when you grow? Sometimes it’s hard to control the stage fright … stepping on stage was a challenge this team was ready for. The glow of the spotlight wasn’t too hot for this team. The judges are so happy to go with the flow

This team's robot shined a light on the precision of engineering and innovation. Their robot "clearly" demonstrates the countless hours of dedication and expert team this team has put in, and it’s reliability and performance on the field showed.How do you turn light into energy? Ask this amazing team!

This team pulls out all the stops when it comes to working as a rookie team. Their volunteering with middle schools to promote and inspire students to learn more about science and technology was not a monster of a challenge – it came naturally.

This team demonstrates that they cannot be wrangled by constraints that rookie teams face. They used scraps from other teams to build their wildly successful machine. However, FIRST – and this team – I about more than robots. This team has executed plans and preparations on par with many long tenured teams in their community, school, students, and sponsors. There's no stable that can rein this team in!

Has anyone lost their hearing yet? This team has directly contributed to the ground shaking cheering thought out the competition. Whether it is at 8am, or till they kick us out, this team cheers for their neighbors, the volunteers, and while it may screw with the readings on the seismograph, it doesn’t drive us nuts!.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team shows a very sustainable future. They have one of the ultimate solutions to sustainability challenges – recycling materials into their robot! Got face shields? This team has plenty of them and has put them to good use.
The judges were slayed by this team's ability to score in autonomous. Their robot not only has super senses for shooting but is quick and nimble on the field. Orange you glad we didn't try to rhyme?

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Swerve drives were new and Lua wraps were the glue. This team remained high in the rankings all weekend long, and they were shocked to learn how reliable hanging with a chain-drive hook became!

This team is highlighting the need for inclusive technology education in their school, organization, and community. At competition this team stands tall, especially with the addition from their hair. This team's bright green light is a beacon to inspire all those around them.

The team had a big bang moment. Despite some funding challenges earlier in the season, they continued a high level of mentorship, advocacy, and community outreach, as well as reducing financial barriers to joining FIRST. The judges felt like this team's commitment and future are truly out of this world!

This team goes full circle with their shooter and truly rises above the competition with their climbing. Their unique and elegant solutions to engineering problems have shown their skill from conception to the field!

This young and bright team has a positive attitude especially when others are having difficulties. They put sportsmanship first, and eagerly jump in with a helping hand. They emit the core values of gracious professionalism throughout the pits.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team inspires us to soar to great heights and fun! They fly with their fast beat to reach its crescendo. With their bright blue jumpsuits they just don’t drive but fly.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: There's no denying this team can do it all. From auton to end-game, they pounced on every opportunity to score. With flashing lights and attractive powder coating, this team is nimble as a cat.

This team's right-hand rule is reliability. They impressed the judges with their "Texas Toast" to control their shooter and swerve. By sharing their innovations, they are multiplying their force by distance.
This team sets the GOLD standard and holds a special place in the judges' hearts. They lead the way and create their path. Their senior class started this team and will leave a strong legacy of FRC.

This young team is metamorphosing in the right direction. From their neatly-managed wiring to their 3D-printed gear box covers, the judges were impressed with the Magnitude of this team's attention to detail. OH YEAH!
This team has strong relationships in our FIRST community, and they are sweetening the prospects in their community. Even though they are a rookie team, they have a great start out of the gates.
This team is rounding up partnerships in their coastal community, and now they're blazing a trail from FTC to FRC! After a hard day of "STEAM Bus" engagement, you'll find them hanging out at the Y!
In the stands and in the pits, this team can't be missed. Cheering and supporting all, this team is your biggest fan! Their bright purple light spreads the spirit of FIRST wherever they go.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: From all parts of the world, this team blooms where they are planted. They work hard to have an impact and achieve long-term continuity. So go green with them and roll out!

Before the humans show up, this team’s bot has already struck four notes. This team is like a bird of prey, perched in the warehouse rafters ready to strike. The design and success of these autonomous functions let the team know, IT CAN do this!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: With a low center of gravity, bottom intake with auto stop via current draw sensing, and a novel triangular structure, would the ideas and ambitions of this team truly pay off? Could they really get 60 foot shots with their intake and shooter? With room and freedom to innovate, this team proved their ambitions with consistent play!

This team can be seen soaring throughout their community as they host many FIRST tournaments and showcase FIRST at many events. This team makes WISE decisions as they reach out globally. This team inspires students across all FIRST programs from FLL to FTC to FRC to FIRST access.

This team had monumental impact on their community while spreading the mission of FIRST. This team was driven to start FLL and FTC teams, and seeing them flourish with mentoring. They advocated with their school district to dramatically increase school funding for STEM in their city. This team was always a ferocious cat, both on the field and in their community, with their measurable and lasting impact.

The fruits of this team’s design process could definitely be seen out on the field. Ready to go in an Old West shoot out, they could load notes driving forward or backwards. They climb, they shoot, they score - these black hat outlaws are in town with an excellent bot to watch.

Now this team certainly isn’t just a plain old team! Whether it’s the floor you’re standing on or the part in your hand, chances are it came from this team. They were able to work within their team to help others achieve their full potential.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s talent spans an entire spectrum, from ultraviolet to infrared. Their unified aesthetic runs from the pit to the bot to the stands. The image they’ve painted is as impeccable as their home town’s beauty.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team’s robot is ready for a full formal white wedding. Their design, alignment, accessibility, and intake shooter combo sets them apart. Their robot has rocked two decades of excellent design.
This team developed a robot with big wing gears driven by heavy metal chain. With excellent control, this bot always rolled 7s. This robot definitely exploded onto the competition scene.

This is the Judge’s Award for Passionate Community Building. Young but mighty, this team is not going to let their age hold them back. Their passion for robotics and STEM is a FORCE for change in their community.

Did this robot spend its summer rock climbing or handing out on the Texas Motor Speedway? This robot’s sleek design, impressive team, and Limelight implementation proved itself over the last two days. Color us impressed with their consistent field play, 1 note autos, and gorgeous chain climb.

This team was well-structured, organized, and driven. This team understood the assignment with impact and outreach extending farther than just their local community. There’s nothing junior about this sister team.

When this team received help this year, they sought to pay it forward. This rookie team took the values of FIRST to heart. This team is passionate about the future of robotics inside their team and out.

This team is big and bold with their presence both visually and audibly. Their community team spirit is displayed through their green visuals that stand out among the crowd. Like bear, they take care of their cubs!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Maybe a team saw their bot go south this weekend, but this team went north - grandly! This team has built a strong sustainable pipeline through extensive fundraising and local FLL competitions. This team covers the full range of their community needs to build a strong community foundation.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow

records.script: This team's precise shooter consistently scores in autonomous. They effortlessly seize the notes as if prey. Like a hawk, they strike with unmatched accuracy and efficiency, securing their alliance’s success.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Zipping accross the field it didn't matter where they were. Whether facing forward or backwards, this team's shooter always makes the shot. Their unique intake design gives them a wide *range* to succeed.

Reching beyong FRC, this team has encouraged their members to use their skills to inspire others in special ways. Founding and running a political advocacy conference in Texas to provide for STEM grants across Texas. We APPRECIATE the efforts from this team.

The winner of this year's FIRST Impact Award has built a culture that includes mentoring, volunteerism and advocacy. Participation in citywide events provides exposure that helps inspire young students and recruit new members as well as building connections that help sustain the team. Their impact includes starting more than a dozen teams for young students in their community and surrounding areas as well as starting three international teams. A safe space for LGBTQ students and menotrs, they have successfully advocated for STEM funding in Texas at the national level. Participating in FIRST Access events to encourage the differently-abled to engage in STEAM and volunteering at every level from FLL Explorer to FIRST Global rounds out some of this team's many activities. So let's risk it for the brisket--this year's Impact Award winner, Team 2714, BBQ!

Failure analysis is an important aspect of engineering design. When others may stop, this team is *energized* to work on the next itteration. This team demonstrates elegence in engineering integration, trobleshooting, design methodology, and documentation. From intake to shooter this team is fully *charged* to take on the competition.

This team adhears to the principles of gracious profesionalism. They're known as much for lending a helping hand as well as for their colorful presence wherever they go. When the judges think GP, the judges think Pink.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team's CAN-do attitude brightened our day. We really loved their vinyl covered robot and their pit. There's no denying the aesthetic of this team and theres no denting their TINacity.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team distinguishes itself with its simple and efficent design; taking charge on the field with no fear. Their robot is comprised of modules, so their subsystems can be easily replaced in case something goes wrong. Their forward planning has helped them exell in the judges eyes.

This team managed to iron out any controls issues by incorporating passive mechanisms. With the strategic integration of springs, they added a unique element of innovation. By keeping things simple, it was plain to see they were destined for great success.

The judges wanted to give a special appreciation to the efforts of this team. This team wrote and published a childrens book about the FIRST experience. Even though this event started out rocky these beasts made "My First Robotics Competition" feel welcoming.

With this bot, there was no problem that could *buck* it from working well. It was clear their many wonderful ideas were not pulled from a hat, but our hats were off to their impressive manufacturing. From the machining to the gearing, these cowboys did a quality job.

We truley believe in the future of this ream. Far from shallow, great depths were undertaken to prevent them from going under. Late nights searching for sponsors and working with partners will allow them to see the stars they truely are.
Despite being new to the competition this team's clockwork was tightly wound. They sprung with enthusiasm in every conversation we had with them. This goose is sure to gain momentum.
No ruffled feathers here! This team flew through the field with great spirit. They never let any obsticle ground their enthusiasm.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Ths team sustains *horsepower* by creating a *heard* of future recruits by mentoring FLL and FTC teams as well as hosting workshops for anyone interested in robotics. They also value the envoronment, and have embraced filiment recycling of old parts to reduce their environmental *hoof-print*.

This team soared through the autonomous section of the competition. When the match begins, their robot awakens – a sentinel with the ability to sense its surroundings, calculate trajectories, and bring points home with such refinement that it looks like the innate instinct of a predator. The reliability and performance of this robot speak to the experience and dedication of the whole flock.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: The creativity of this team is simply electric. With a carbon fiber climber that defies convention, their design was not only innovative but practical. May their climber continue to unroll new possibilities, inspiring others to think beyond the obvious.

FIRST members and furry enthusiasts of precision and innovation, today we honor a team that has elevated engineering to an art form. This team’s high-altitude journey has culminated in a nexus of gears, circuits, and ingenuity. Their robot, like an Erector Set masterpiece, boasts a sea of blue, peppered with cameras of all-seeing eyes, both googley and functional, capturing every detail in the field. Autonomously, they navigate with the precision of a watchmaker.

This team did an incredible job at swooping in to uplift other teams. Their outstanding contributions to others have made many teams sing their praises. Their grace, Professionalism, and desire to help others borders on Angelic.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Dressing the part, this team definitely stands apart from the crowd. Chaotic and out of control is not a trait that is exhibited by this team's cohesive appearance. Guiding robotic rats in a maze might well be the job of these yellow-robed lab assistants.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team’s robot shows the unwavering commitment to industrial design principles- a harmonious blend of form, functions, and practicality. Redundancy isn’t a luxury; it’s a strategic advantage. Every subassembly whispers of expertise. The fit and finish, like a bespoke suit, reveals their commitment to excellence. With the bold clash of black and red, the hexagonal motifs run through every bolt and wire. It’s not accidental; it is intentional.

This team was able to blend their control elements into a seamless symphony, an orchestra of electrical, mechanical and software harmonics. From autonomous excellence to on-field performance, controls and mechanics were not left to chance. Even their sponsors helped in more ways than one to deal a winning hand.

Heating up STEM and robotics education, this team showed excellence in professionalism, engineering, mentoring, and team support; developed a curriculum for elementary school STEM education and created education kits with videos. Their fiery attitude has certainly spiced up the competition.

Emerging from the heart of Salt Lake City their journey has been a symphony of craftsmanship, attention to detail, and unwavering commitment. The wiring was meticulously organized, like a conductor’s score. A quality checklist guides their every move, from CAD models to assembly.

This team lent a hand year-round, reaching out to and inspiring their community. They offer hands-on mentoring and support at all FIRST levels and handy STEM education in schools and at home. There’s no question about this team, hands up!

This team’s commitment to expanding STEM has been unwavering. They have brought FIRST to all corners of their state, inspiring future generations. This team has demonstrated they “can do hard things” by cracking open the barriers to STEM in the indigenous community.

This team emerged from the foothills of the Salt Lake Valley embarking on their soaring ascent into the world of engineering. Their robot spins in circles in a unique twist to the competition. These Griffins expertly blend myth and machinery on their wings inspiring dreams of engineering and shaping a brighter future.

The team’s passion for helping each other came through as loud as a pack of barking dogs. An inspiring, energetic, and caring team that includes every person independent of their ability, background, or interest. The team spirit is as strong as whisky and as loyal as pet dogs.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Elevating everyone around them, this team supported multiple FLL, FTC, and FRC teams, participated in civic activities, and raised over $119K for other teams. They continue to soar higher and higher while pulling others with them.

A team who wanted to harmonize robot and driver. To automate navigation and shooting with a vision toward autocorrect following collision Already scoring at least 5 in auto giving their driver extra time to get ready

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team was determined to excel in every aspect of the game, aiming to score across all facets. Their elegant intake and hopper design allowed them to redirect and score with precision and accuracy. Their innovative design had them blazing above the competition.
This team is looking to maintain their success. They built a structure that is unmatched. They’re certainly not Evergreen.

They boldy spread the FIRST mission where no robot dared to go. They impacted the FIRST community by smashing pumpkins and barriers. Inspiring the STEM future through the loud roar of robots across their territory. Let the small but mighty ROAR!
This team demonstrates serious engineering design in practice. They are on an adventure of discovery and learning. No joking around about scoring and strategy

Within their local area and at competitions, this team stretches and leaps to support others. The team collectively finds ways to offer a helping fin to those in need. You’re always invited to be a member of their pod

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Bringing together the lines and angles of engineering with the hum and power of Crescendo, this team created visual views of engineering harmony while incorporating their strong brand identity. They blended the strength of the five sided pentagon with the five lines of music.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team is trying to make a space for more robots and inspire the creation of new teams. They didn’t paint themselves into a square, but fabricated a beautiful example which showcases all of their open fabrication processes.

This team endeavored to simplify the lives of their drivers. Utilizing a robust custom drive train and employing LED’s to signal note possession, the drivers on this team effortlessly navigated the forge of the competition.

The Community Driven Preparedness Award Inspired to make match queuing easier for teams, this team took it upon themselves to design an elegant tool for all teams to use. With bumper color warnings, match schedule and a countdown clock to gametime, they are always prepared. If you need to remember a match, remember The Titans!

As teams fly around the field, they have to be both durable and light weight. Using advanced simulations, this team created parts that are strong where it counts. They’ve created a machine that sings in Perfect Harmony.
A Team trying to manage turmoil needed to come together as a community to produce a strong competitor. This group bonded, creating a unique and powerful nucleus.
This team worked to get the entire crowd involved because they know the importance of team spirit. You probably already know their chant 6 what?? 612

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team builds sustainability be being recognized as a varsity sport at their school and using the lower grades as a feeder system to FRC. They set up their team structure to utilize the buddy system to train freshmen by upper classmen. They also created online tools to document engineering processes for future teams to make use of. The only team that does its pre match chants in Latin and the best use of flannel.
Successful autonomous programs perform well for both Red and Blue. The judges know that machine learning is great insurance. This team’s careful programming was no accident!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Creativity comes from a spectrum of ideas and flexile thinking. Sometimes they work, sometimes not – but you can’t have it both ways, and it takes more than luck. The judges couldn’t help but be lured in by this team!
Like a meteor, this team STEAMED full speed ahead to regenerate. Their commitment to educate and sustain was cosmically successful. Their efforts to rebuild were as epic as a comet’s trajectory!

Their color might be maroon, but their rookies are never left behind. We found a team that conducts outreach better than copper conducts electricity! This team's thorough documentation showed us that they truly learn by teaching.
Modular design can make for quick fixes. Shining a light on elegant design, this team’s origami-inspired approach unfolded to reveal great results.
This community-based team really made a splash with their outreach. There is not anything to CARP about this group. They graciously swam to the top of the judges list.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: The stars have aligned with this diverse community team. Their twin spirits are thriving. The judges loved the cohesive look this team created when Phil and Rosie got together under one purple and green roof!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team spent a lot of time with their gears turning. Simple and robust design was what the judges were seeking. But in the end, there can be only one.
Innovative control is no small feat – you need to be an animal in programming, teamwork and communication. This team really took a bite out of it with their lean, mean machine.

Students came for the ice cream, and stayed for the robots. The theme of food and all of the good qualities of this team really caught the hungry judges eyes! Having breakfast with politicians, advocacy, and SPREADING knowledge show us that it ain’t easy being cheezy!
A team can learn from last year’s mistakes. While tool quality can haunt you, logs with proactive maintenance spelled a win for this team.
This team graduated from FTC to FRC. Their STUFF is shooting for the moon! This rookie team should go far – to infinity and beyond!
This community team reinvented themselves, inspiring others with putting the ‘Y’ in YouTube. Their success cannot be denied. This team unleashed their WHY at this tournament.
There is no need to be green with envy about this team’s enthusiasm. The judges are a big “fawn”! This team’s herd has grown 44% in the last year, but that is no reason to “fear the deer.”

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team was blue, but had positive growth through their outreach. To be budget-conscious, they make use of their scrap bucket and last year’s robot; so they were able to fly to new heights in the judges’ eyes.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: This team represents their community with humility. They are skilled at playing notes of self-reliant code. Coding is this FARM team’s secret crop.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team CLEANED UP with a list of innovative features They SWEPT the Judges off their feet with a creative approach to the game, HOOKING them with this design. This aptly named robot could be the next TikTok star.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: This team’s efforts to promote engineering will not rust. Their reach stretches from the hallways of their school to the halls of legislature. Their dedication to mentoring and volunteering made it clear to the Judges that FIRST Core Values SNAKE though this team’s efforts and they will continue to inspire others for years to come!

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: This inspirational team is an advocate for diversity and inclusion to the highest levels, championing for Pride, Autism, and Neurodiversity. Collaborating with numerous partners, this team is a role model for local businesses and not for profits seeking them out to make a difference! Hard work pays off with high attendance and demand for summer programs. Instilling a sense of community, they have formed alliances with area teams to maximize collaboration and share resources. This strong steam is helping to build a sustainable future… GRANTing autonomy to emerging FLL teams. With sword and shield, this family-like, multifaceted team lives by their “No CUTS, No FEEs, No EXPERIENCE Required” motto.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: On the field of play this team evokes ancient traditions. Their professional ancestry goes deep as their performance is elegant. From small beginnings they persist and build on form and function in a way that stands the test time.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: This team is never short of a tool to share or a hand to help. Their support even extends to the field with their robot helpfully moving out of the way when needed. Their Gracious Professionalism is consistent in their efforts to help and mentor other teams.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: The Judges were hooked by this team’s pit. Everything from their robot to their shirts, and even their bumpers make this team GLIMMER in the sun. One thing is certain, this team is not KOI about their imagery.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: In the arena of innovation, a quest begins in space. This team’s robot is a testament to ingenuity and robustness with elegant hints of purple that gleam under a starlight sky. This team of KNIGHTS fly in with a creation that shines brightly in the realm of industrial elegance.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: The stars aligned for this team, who proved they were solidly IN CONTROL. They defied gravity and really turned things UPSIDE DOWN. The Judges were blown away by this interstellar EXPLOSION.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: You can feel this innovative team’s presence from far away. Their innovations make robotics accessible to help light up more people with the spirit of FIRST. The impact of these THUNDERBOLTS sake the ground we all stand upon.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: To win this year’s Crescendo competition an alliance needs to AMP it up. This winning team built a reliable, effective robot that delivers points for any alliance. Stand up and turn around three times to celebrate this HELIX.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: The Judges saw this new team sailing across the cosmos. They embody FIRST Core Values as ambassadors of good will and collaboration. This STARY team leaves their mark on and off the field.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.script: Lighting up the sky, this team was impossible to ignore. They’ve embodied unwavering enthusiasm and spirit within their team and throughout the community. This COMET will blaze brightly for a long time.

records.eventName: CHS District Falls Church VA Event presented by Department of Energy
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team had all the right moves on and off the field. Their unwavering commitment to environmental stewardship and sustainable practices empowers others to follow in their footsteps. More than skin deep, this team believes in their motto to “Keep FIRST Beautiful”.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: Determined to dominate in competition, this team took a unique approach to their autonomous strategy. THis team's innovative use of sensors seamlessly integrated into their code to ensure consistency both in autonomous and tele-op. With an all in one shoot button and a simple climb sequence, this team was able to “orca-strate” their alliance to victory time and time again.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team’s robot had a weight problem. For them to soar they have to lighten their load. Their nested springs let them reach their goals.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: This team recruits like no other. Their outreach is both domestic and international. Their jackets may be metal, but their heart is warm while ensuring everyone is welcome in STEM.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: This team didn't just bring the heat in competitions, they melted the hearts and minds of the judges. With their outreach stretching from Virginia to distant lands, they are inspiring a new generation of science and technology WHIZZES. In the world of STEM advocacy, they aren't just good, they aren't just GOUDA, they are GRATE.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: This team’s design is a testament to form and function. Their robust arm design was able to keep their team scoring in all aspects of the game. With a zest for precision and a knack for repairability, this team not only squeezed out success, but turned lemons into engineering marvels.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: This team knew the rules of the game. They saw an opponent stranded and drove around, letting them be. They BUCKED the rules of convention and played fairly, even at personal detriment.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: From their pits to their shirts, to the bot itself, this team is hard to miss. Their ability to seamlessly integrate their brand into all that they do is top match. Their neon green glow and radioactive personality definitely made them an element of their own

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team is able to conduct extensive repairs in record time. Their robot has an adjustable & modular design that protects vital components with Engineering grade material. With it’s sleek & innovative design this robot is a fitting tribute to it’s namesake.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: The drivers for this team can CONDUCT their robot on the field with ease. Every system works in concert, while keeping an eye on the field at all times. With long distance aiming, their machine is anything but JUNK.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: This team is always willing to lend an EAR in their community. They reuse the HUSKS of their lucky robots. The way that COLONEL CORNELIUS CORNWALL plays cornhole always pops.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: This team's elegant robot captivated everyone's attention on & off the field. Their dedication to engineering & meticulous attention to detail has kept their robot AFLOAT. Their sleek and well thought out team SAILING straight to victory.

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.script: This team was always cheering through their ups and downs. Defying expectations this team rallied around defense. This team’s chant was echoed by the teams and field staff alike. WALL WALL WALL

records.eventName: CHS District Glen Allen VA Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team leverages their business savvy to weather any storm, While their custom training tools ensure rookies SOAR through training and are ready to compete Employing a scrum and agile, they deftly navigate project management tools to Claw their way to success.

This team's members worked diligently to create a robot that efficiently sinks multiple nodes. Working diligently was a primary goal to overcome deficiencies of the past. The team rose from the ashes to create a robot that operates on its own.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team's robot design and attention to detail was second to none. Their unique solutions, inventive strategies, and collaborative spirit have them FLYING above the competition. By implementing their mission statement, "Build, Fly, Dream," they have made a positive impact on others.

This team is soaring through their community, inspiring STEM and robotics. They are nesting the young and disabled, building a smarter, better tomorrow. They have flown away with engineering inspiration.
They spread their wings to reach our to delegates for STEM advocacy. They swarmed together to help kickstart teams internationally. They showed that STEM is not just a boy thing.

This team stands as the epitome of technical prowess and collective achievements. By balancing the scales, this team has mastered meticulous design and problem solving by pushing the boundaries of their robot. Their ability to seamlessly integrate cutting edge technology with practical applications is sharp like talons.

This team embodies the entire manual from start to finish of what it is to be a life changing robotics program. Their influence continues to be engrained into the DNA of the community. Gracious professionalism is the backbone of this team's molecular structure.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team soars through the air with their creativity. The Enterprise has a collective unique style. They assimilated outstanding visual presentation of machine and team appearance.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: With their ingenious design, one team swam head on in their design concept. Their foresight in ease of accessibility made quick work for repairs on and off the field. You won't catch this team lying on their back with more than one way to score points.

This team's robot scoured the field looking for notes left on the floor. All of the teams pursue notes on the field, but only this team's robot was sweeping them up. The team's janitorial robot helped them clean up notes for their "dustpan" to put away.

The Melody Award for Academic Excellence From the skies over Northern Virginia, this team has delivered community service like a bolt out of the blue. Their electrifying dedication to research-based outreach has made a thunderous impact on the academic community. Their alumni have shocked George Washington University and Yale where their research programs continue today.
When workmanship was required, this team did not go down with the ship. Through their use of robustness, they were able to navigate treacherous waters. This team was in command of quality.

This team rode in like a thief in the night with their high spirited display of perseverance that was clearly FOUND during the competition. There was no ERROR in well this team rallied with the community to bounce back after adversity. Allowing them to put team spirit in the driver's seat and take off with this award.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: It is no fantasy that this team has a long term vision for their program. They have a supernatural ability to inspire their local elementary school using salvaged robots. They have summoned a culture of positive environmental impact.

They've SADDLED UP their design process incorporating redundancy in things like the hook feature. They've also delivered on performance for the autonomous phase, GALLOPING all four notes --- did I say notes?! I meant HORSESHOES! Consistently, game after game these people don't just HORSE AROUND. They give a NEON performance that deserves this award!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team built a machine that does a lot of things well. But they also know that to have an effective robotic system, the details have to be SOLID. They made effective use of 3D printing in multiple materials to move those details work and to absorb impacts in an energy effective and SPARTAN way.

Being a FIRST team does not mean just looking at your community but at other teams. With their commitment to FLL, their ORANGE really shines. As this team name says- they just might be the first generations on MARS!

The judges know that you will have no TROUBLE understanding why this team earned this award. They addressed multiple barriers of entry by advocating for and empowering gender minorities and neurodivergent students. Their impressive fundraising has enabled them to take the CAKE when it comes to supporting camps and other FIRST programs. The support of their school's arts and theater program was a wonder to BEHOLD. After going to our capitol and giving our representatives HECK, they still managed to answer the long lost question, is FRC Battle Bots? We are confident that the several FLL and FTC teams they started, mentored and sponsored locally AND globally will Live Long and Prosper! "Beam them down, Scotty!"

This team followed a clear, BLACK AND WHITE engineering process to get from understanding the game to playing here this weekend. Step by step they progressed through their stages while team members SNFFED OUT good designs in their reviews. Building on their foundation, the judges add STEP 12: win award.

Fostering partnerships with teams make them stand out from the HERD. Reaching out, learning in ways large and small: always gracious, promoting equity, lending parts and a hand. Lets GALLOP forward and cheer for our gracious professionals.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team embraced CRESCENDO! They brought BRIGHT colors and SPEAKERS to their stage. This team amped it up with COLORFUL PANTS and their NEON robot.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team has certainly not WINGING it with their design process. With their 3D printed parts on and off the field, you'll know when they come TAPPING at your workshop door. With FEATHERS, FIDGETS, and FABULOUS Gantt charts the Industrial Design award is presented to Team 5683 RAVEN

This team is coming in HOT with their innovative design. This team is in control even when their GOOGLY EYES aren't. How many ERRORS can you find in their CODE? ZERO. The Innovation in Control Award goes to 1425 Error Code Zero.

The Judges are presenting the SILVER Pennigar This Team is a well POLISHED effort both on and off the field, with their machined aluminum accents and brilliant swag, they caught the judges eye. Empowering women in engineering by helping local Girl Scout Troops earn their robotics badge and creating a safe space for women in FIRST to better to communicate with each other, this team is a WARRIOR of inclusivity within FIRST. Auburn please grab your SHIELDS and KNIT HELMETS, the VIKINGS are comin on down

The materials and build quality of this robot has stood out above the rest. This team had a grand vision of combining DINOSAURS with robotics and RO-BOTS-NESS. Please help us celebrate this years Quality award winner TINK REX!! Good job team 8051!

This team builds technical knowledge while having FUN! They used CONSTRUCTION, COMMITMENT, and COMMUNITY to create a team destined for greatness. They're conquering challenges and supporting each other through out of the CUBE thinking.

This team has build a solid RECIPE for success. Strategic research into the key INGREDIENTS of FIRST. They are tactical, technical, design expertise; a vision across cultures to FLAVOR a brand new community.

Sound the trumpets! All PIECES in place! This team spoke with enthusiastic CLARITY about how further the objectives of FIRST: working together, meeting ideas, and CHAMPIONING STEM across THEIR BOARD. Lets CROWN our spirit champion.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Like a TREE this team grows stronger every year. They're building a FOREST that goes BEYOND their borders that will SUSTAIN their community for years to come. Hear all about it on their internationally reaching PODCAST.
Coming in as cool as *ice* With autonomous routines verified *thrice* Even when targets leave their vision, their robot remembers to *chill out* and shoot with precision.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team's fingers played the notes of their success. Their intake really took a bite out of the competition. They really surfed the waves of success.

This past summer, this team started robotic camps and took their robot to a car show. This and their STEM fairs brought them 11 new teammates. Last fall they started a rookie FTC team and had the new teammates create bunny bots. This team really inspires!

This team impressed the judges with how they spread and utilize STEM skills to those in their community. Not only do they support eight FLL teams and three FTC teams but have also become beacons of support in their community, hosting numerous events to uplift young minds in technology, ensuring ROBOTICS FOR ALL. But, their commitment extends beyond robotics; they've built ramps and modified gardens, ensuring ACCESSIBILITY and INCLUSION are more than just words in their community. They've also tackled societal issues head-on, making significant strides in menstrual equity and empowering student voices through LEGISLATION. These WILD islanders are the PURR-fect model for other teams to emulate!

This team stood big and tall from the start of the season. Inspired by the DoD acquisition processes, they clawed their way through system design reviews, ensuring key robot requirements and design are captured with configuration management software. Utilizing the Systems Engineering V-model, they knew their claws were verified and metal was validated

Professional kindness reminds us that relaxed enthusiasm brings many big feet home. A massive outreach to middle schools, summer camps, varsity sports, art students, and rocket makers brought in two dozen new teammates. Creating 1-on-1 relationships with their two FTC teams got 100% of them to join their FRC team.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: On and off the field, they are BRIGHT, both robot and team. Exemplifying FIRST's core values with their FEATHERY outfits, this team has a history of being GREEN. They can be seen anywhere, TREADING with pride.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team brought their animal instincts to the robot design process Their clean machine integrated mechanical functions with software to implement the constraints on their "must do" list The gears were exquisitely machined and placed with care to create a *supersonic* machine)
Not wishing to be too "laconic" We simply found their bot harmonic With limelight it scotts in dogged pursuit These spartans can play supersonic!

This team is fostering a culture of well-being and allowing their team members to grow. Combined with conducting regular climate surveys and allowing their members to gain valuable skills, they ensure their team is a safe place for everyone to become well-ROUNDed individuals. You can say the judges believe this crimson team EARNED THEIR SHELL.
This team is very intentional with their choices. They design their tackle carefully, matching the bait. They really *reel* in the quality.
The match is set with this new team on the field. They are open sided to compete in all rapid sided enclosures. But you can *C* through their newness. Don't allow them to CUBE you in!!!

I know a team whose spirit is really picking up steam. Prioritizing mental health and each other, they lift each other up in all they do. Like birds of a feather, they flock together with enthusiasm and strength.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is electric and really shines off the field. They rise their team to the *sky* and *walk* their new team members through the ropes of the competition. Teaching *Padawans* helps this team not only be green.

This team pursued their robot’s autonomous functions with smarts in mind. Sensing its surroundings with a SYMPHONY of cameras and sensors, their robot effectively and reliably detects notes. It then orchestrates the perfect position toward the speaker, incorporating nifty translation tables, even when the robot is moving. For MAESTRO, their robot is a TITAN on the field.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Search high, look low These beasts are on the go Shooting over, maybe under There’s two spots they mainly plunder The judges enjoyed the ease of their switches Notes flying like flame from their mouths without glitches

This team’s recruiting efforts have spawned explosive growth. Their SWOT analysis of their training led to a day-by-day plan to get their rookies ready for the season. You can see them taking FIRST to the STREETS if you visit their booth at Salmon Days.

Their well READ members create and distribute documentation and run workshops to share their knowledge with other teams. Their expansive outreach spans the globe. They lobby congress to create legislation that benefits the TOTEal FIRST community. They run free summer camps to provide STEM opportunities to students facing economic hardship. Their presentation left the judges AMPED UP.
When you see this team, you know excellence is a fact They sort out their parts to keep on track They took inspiration, made it their own This isn’t the alphabot, this is baritone
This team takes gracious professionalism to center stage. When other teams need a part, their recycling initiative is a great start, This team makes FIRST values POP.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: While this team’s color doesn’t RHYME, that didn’t stop this team from building a cohesive image. From what’s on the robot to what’s worn by the team, they really REACH out to spread their theme. The judges were a real SUCKER for this team and would like to welcome them with all eight arms.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team’s design process was more than just BLACK AND WHITE. The judges’ followed their NOSE to learn about their 11-step system and design reviews. The team’s process led to each subcomponent being seamlessly integrated into their robot. They didn’t have to “GET LUCKY” to have a robot that’s “Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger.”

The judges were wowed by this team’s sleek and smart robot. Using state machines, their robot can be operated effectively with just the press of a couple buttons. The team also LOOKED AHEAD not only with their dynamic flywheels but ensuring that none of those wheels wear out faster. This team is clearly looking over the HORIZON toward their next mission to Mars.

FRC is about building community. Building inclusivity and diversity requires the awareness and efforts of each member of the team. This team has experienced a surge of membership and built strong LINKS with their new members, saying “No prior knowledge required. We will make you a nerd.” They also maintain links with their alumni and mentors. The judges have named this award “The Inclusive Community Award” and recognize this team for their outstanding efforts to include everyone.

This orange team stands out not only up in the stands, but down in the arena. Their robot majestically roams the field, looking for notes to PROMPTly pick up and shoot with ease, elegance, and SPARKLE. It’s simple in design but thoughtfully effective, with some nicely organized electrical wiring. The judges are eagerly awaiting this team, they’re saying, “LET’S GO, PRONTO!”

Let’s take a sec to learn what these kids are cooking Each student adds flavor, and contributes to stirring These young Michelin chefs have impressed, raised the floor The future is bright for these rookies, for sure.
This team isn’t just racing down the field to give it their all. They’re building up the community and active at City Hall When you need to be inspired the writing is on the wall.

This team enthusiastically marches across the board to the beat of their guitar. They have struck a chord with the community through their viral social media. They move their friendship bracelets around teams as fast as they move their pieces around the game. And X marks the spot of the quiet rooms they help host. These queens reign supreme with an infectious team spirit.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team built a continuous improvement plan to grow and sustain their members, their team, and their community. As you would expect, new members are trained on the technical stuff, but each member is also trained in LIGHTNING speed to be a leader. They actively promote reuse and recycle, while investing in ways to reduce their emission footprint. The judges recognize the ENERGY needed to develop their vision of the future and their structured 1 and 3 year plans for community sustainability.
No getting AROUND this team’s performance. Their multi-note auto brought music to the judges’ ears. Their autonomous scoring is EASY AS PI.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Don’t be SURPRISED that this team demonstrated how they CAN be creative. Their CUSTOM PCB reduced wiring complexity and demonstrated an improvement in signal integrity. This team’s not HIDING how their constant trying of new things gave them an edge on the field.

This team spreads STEM to their community through FLL camps, curriculum, and financial support. They actively encourage girls and non-binary students in STEM, both on their team and beyond. They AMPED UP their efforts by taking FIRST to a government level, testifying in front of the Washington State legislature to pass one of the first bills in the nation sponsoring STEM education. Olympia knows them as bill 5617, but THINK AGAIN, we know them as 2412.

This team impressed the judges with their commitment to their expanding collection of 71 FIRST teams across all programs. They FORGED an inclusive world by being Unified Robotics ambassadors for 3 seasons, helping to bring the initiative to Oregon, Minnesota, and all the way down to Australia. They GEARed up gender and low-income minorities with 6 free monthly STEM workshops, teaching students LEGO robotics, Scratch, and Java. This team founded an all-encompassing FLL curriculum to make FIRST more accessible. They partnered with teachers and implemented it across 6 elementary schools, 13 classrooms, and 292 students. It was not a calculus problem to pick this team for the Impact Award. A big SALUTE to Team 4131.

This team ENLIGHTENED the judges on their iterative design process, guided by overarching engineering principles. We felt WELL-RED after reviewing the detailed strategy and processes in their engineering notebook. They ENERGETICALLY explained the impact of their continuous improvement on their robot.

This team spells their take on Gracious Professionalism in their own way: “B” Building people, not just robots. “U” Understanding FIRST core values “I” Inspiring inclusion and safe spaces “L” Leading the way for menstruation education “D” Drafting a bill for student advocacy “S” Strawberries have DNA too

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team stood out to the judges by integrating their team persona and robot design, fully embracing STEAM by HAMMERING out a theme that works well both on the field and in the stands. In a SEA of teams, they are making big waves in the waters of the PNW but despite the SHARKS in the water, this team is always ready to HANG TEN. We don't have to wait for the water game, there's already a TSUNAMI on the field! Let’s RIDE THE WAVE…

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team took a COLORFUL approach to designing their robot. Their innovative 3d-printing GEARED them up for competition. They successfully LINKED together a cohesive design.
Notes in this team’s grasp play to their TUNE. With pairs of sensors, they have their notes SQUARED. For these MUSICAL RODENTS, software and control is an advantage.

When searching for SIGNS, the judges found this team stood out for their communication skills. This team’s efforts TRANSLATE to increased accessibility within robotics in their school and at competitions. When it comes to INCLUSION, this team takes the CROWN. The Judges present the DHH Outreach Award to:
This team put their PAWS to work to craft a detailed bot. Their immaculate wiring would make others GREEN with envy. They definitely don’t JEST when it comes to quality.
A robot with three notes in their autopass. The BRICKS in their WALL have our autographs. If you scan their QR code, It is in STEM outreach mode. They are HATCHING big plans on their FIRST pass.

If you’re looking for fun and laughter, this team is OPEN for business. They COOK UP a welcoming environment with their alliances and mentorships. When it comes to their cohesive theme and enthusiasm, this team isn’t NOODLING around.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: With a dynamic organizational framework, this team's management is AGILE on and off the field. Creating a work back schedule and sharing it with their team leads, this team ensures they will meet their deadlines this season and the next. Working with Legislators and Government figures these FUTURE STEM LEADERS will be here to stay. This team has created a foundation for success by ensuring funding for this year and more to come. Get ready to HOP on down team 101 101 1000011

records.script: When the competition showed up to play, this team brought the HEAT. This team’s use of AI to capture notes and augment scoring during teleop BLAZED the trail for scoring. The judges were FOND of their Automation.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: LIGHTNING struck multiple times during this team’s brainstorming sessions. They amped up the field with a one arm climber and an intake the full width of their robot all while bringing an element of class to the stage with their white BOWTIES.

This teams starts with a SMALL but SOLID base. Their VISION to use a single element to perform multiple tasks demonstrates a clear understanding in the engineering process. True to their name, this is one ENLIGHTENED team!

This team showcase’s GP through their family atmosphere and respect for other FIRST community members. This team inspires FIRST core values by hosting robot schools and scrimmages with neighboring teams. They even taught a GOAT to program…

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team blends well into Wisconsin’s identity and can fit into any county fair. From the team’s attire to the warm-up suit for the robot, this team is not hard to SPOT.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: You won’t be BOARD watching this bot DASH around the fields. Coding a way to keep in TUNE with the notes this team was able to innovate their way to the WINS.
This Team’s innovation in Control was a WORK OF ART. This team uses mathematical equations and graphing of data to position and control the robot. This team left their TAG on this competition.

This team has developed many HAPPY CAMPERS through their STEM camps for younger students. Their STEM education and mental health initiatives are strengthening their community. There’s no taming this BEAST.

This high-quality team is full of energy. It is clear their careful use of tools like DFMEA’s and checklists power their robot and team to success. Continued quality DELIVERY is certainly in store for this team.

This is a team built like a family acting on the belief that “KNOWLEDGE IS SUSTAINABLE”. This team sniffs out talent and inspires engineering engagement from Pre-K through High School. Like a DOG WITH A BONE, this team relentlessly pursues Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion to build a stronger team.

This team has a REVOLVING array of initiatives. From supporting local hospitals to destigmatizing mental health, this team is foundation of their community. YOU GO with this team all over the world, as they foster an inclusive support network within FIRST. “But Toto-There’s no place like home!”

This team came to play the game. They engaged their community with Cub Scouts and FLL, bringing children JOY. They STICK to a problem until it’s solved, even if they need to call JENNY. They are definitely ready and prepared for the NEXT LEVEL.
This rookie is SHOCKINGLY diverse. From robot builds, rebuilds and community impact, they are running strong. They have an ELECTRIFYING energy that keeps their small team together.

This team knows how to spread their WINGS. They bring their spirit to new areas by spreading STEM to the gals in their school. You’ll see their mascot in the pits, stands and even at their driver station.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is on POINT with their recruitment efforts. This team sinks their teeth into rookie success and hands-on recycling. Looking towards new horizons, we see sustainability for years to come.
